name: BQE Water Inc.
summary: BQE Water Inc., a water treatment company, provides wastewater treatment services to the mining and metallurgical industry in Canada, the United States, Mexico, Chile, China, and internationally. The company's metal recovery and removal technologies include BioSulphide and ChemSulphide technologies, which use biological or chemical sources of sulphide to precipitate dissolved metals from mining wastewater; and Met-IX technology that treats wastewater. It also offers sulphate technologies, such as Sulf-IX and Sulf-IXC, which removes sulphate and hardness from wastewater; selenium removal technology, including Selen-IX that removes selenium from mining wastewater; and cyanide treatment technologies, such as SART, a process technology to remove the metallurgical interference of cyanide-soluble metals in gold cyanidation. The company was formerly known as BioteQ Environmental Technologies Inc. and changed its name to BQE Water Inc. in March 2017. The company primarily explores for and trades in cobalt, copper, tin, tantalum, and tungsten. It holds a 70% interest in two contiguous concessions that cover an area of 40.8 square kilometers located to the east of Kolwezi; and 80% interest in two contiguous concessions covering an area of 7.6 square kilometers located in Lubumbashi. The company was formerly known as Peat Resources Limited and changed its name to Cobalt Blockchain Inc. in March 2018. Cobalt Blockchain Inc. is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.

name: Coast Copper Corp.
summary: Coast Copper Corp. is a Canadian exploration-stage company that searches for and assesses mineral properties, targeting silver, gold, copper, magnetite and iron. Among its significant assets is its option to acquire full ownership of the Empire Mine property in the Rupert District on northern Vancouver Island, British Columbia. It was incorporated in 2011 and has its head office in Vancouver, Canada.

name: Collingwood Resources Corp.
summary: Collingwood Resources Corp. is a company listed on the TSX Venture Exchange under the ticker COLL-P and traded in CAD.

name: Canada One Mining Corp.
summary: Canada One Mining Corp., an exploration stage company, acquires, explores, and develops, and evaluates mineral deposits in Canada. It primarily explores for copper, gold, lead, zinc, silver, nickel, palladium, and platinum group elements; as well as base and precious metals. The company owns 100% interest in Copper Dome Project covering an area of 7,997 hectares located in Princeton, British Columbia; Zeus gold property located in Lillooet, British Columbia; and Goldrop property located in Princeton, British Columbia. The company was formerly known as Anglo-Canadian Mining Corp. and changed its name to Canada One Mining Corp. in August 2017. Canada One Mining Corp. was incorporated in 1979 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.

name: NatureBank Asset Management Inc.
summary: NatureBank Asset Management Inc. engages in sourcing, financing, development, and commercialization of sustainable commodity projects in the agro-forestry and carbon sectors in Canada, Germany, rest of Europe, the United States, and internationally. Its agroforestry services include sustainable forest management, process improvement, and arid lands, as well as solutions for cocoa production; and ecosystem services comprise feasibility assessments, evaluation tools, forest restoration, and GIS and modeling. The company also provides carbon management services, such as project development, CCBA development, forest restoration, indigenous communities, and certification, as well as forestry, community based land management, remote sensing, and geospatial analysis services; and supply chain risk analysis, climate risk services of natural resource planning, life cycle assessment, policy and market analysis, offset project development, clean technology, and event impact management services. In addition, it offers advisory, technology, and impact investment services to public and private organizations; sells verified emission reduction units; and provides project development consulting services, and other environmental consulting services. The company was formerly known as Offsetters Climate Solutions Inc. and changed its name to NatureBank Asset Management Inc. in October 2015. NatureBank Asset Management Inc. was founded in 2004 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.

name: Camino Minerals Corporation
summary: Camino Minerals Corporation, an exploration stage company, engages in the exploration and development of mineral properties primarily in Peru. The company explores for copper, gold, and silver deposits. It owns 100% interests in the Plata Dorada project, which consists of 6 claims covering an area of 2,100 hectares located in Cuzco, Peru; and the Los Chapitos property that consists of 39 claims covering an area of 22,500 hectares located in department of Arequipa, Peru. Camino Minerals Corporation was incorporated in 2009 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.

name: Coniagas Battery Metals Inc.
summary: Coniagas Battery Metals Inc. explores, develops and mines cobalt, copper, silver and nickel in northern Quebec. The Graal property, a grassroots exploration property for nickel, copper and cobalt northwest of Saguenay, is its flagship project. It was incorporated in 2021 and has its head office in Vancouver, Canada.

name: Cosa Resources Corp.
summary: Cosa Resources Corp. acquires, explores and develops mineral resource properties, with particular focus on exploring its copper and uranium projects. It was founded in 2020 by Wesley Short and has its head office in Vancouver, Canada.

name: Covalon Technologies Ltd.
summary: Covalon Technologies Ltd. researches, develops, manufactures, commercializes, and licenses medical technologies and products in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, Europe, the Middle East, Asia, Latin America, and internationally. The company has five proprietary platform technologies, including collagen matrix platform that is used to manufacture a family of products to treat chronic and infected wounds, including diabetic ulcers, pressure ulcers, venous ulcers, donor and graft sites, traumatic wounds healing by secondary intention, dehisced surgical wounds, and first and second degree burns; antimicrobial silicone adhesive platform that is used for family of pre and post-surgical, and vascular access products that are designed to kill bacteria or yeast that comes into contact with the antimicrobial silicone providing broad-spectrum antimicrobial activity; medical coating platform, a proprietary process that utilizes photo-polymerization to create active grafting sites where new polymer chains are initiated and propagated from the surface of an existing medical device; aquaguard moisture barrier technology, an impermeable moisture barrier that allows the clinician or patient to cover wounds, dressings, and intravenous sites to keep them dry; and covaguard antimicrobial sanitizing technology that incorporates Benzalkonium Chloride into a lipid delivery system to surfaces and skin to kill viruses and bacteria. Its products include wound care dressings; surgical and peri-operative products; infection management products; moisture barriers; and antimicrobial sanitizers under the Covalon brand name. The company sells its products through third-party distribution networks and company's direct sales force. It serves hospitals, wound care centers, burn centers, extended/alternate care and acute care facilities, home health care agencies, and physicians' offices. The company is headquartered in Mississauga, Canada.

name: CopAur Minerals Inc.
summary: CopAur Minerals Inc., an exploration stage company, engages in the acquisition, exploration, and development of mineral properties in Canada. It holds interest in the Williams Gold Copper property covering an area of 6,885.44 hectares located in British Columbia. The company was formerly known as International Samuel Exploration Corp. and changed its name to CopAur Minerals Inc. in August 2020. CopAur Minerals Inc. is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.

name: CopperCorp Resources Inc.
summary: CopperCorp Resources Inc. explores for mineral resources, mainly in Australia, aiming to find copper and gold deposits that are commercially viable. Its portfolio includes ownership stakes in the Alpine and Skyline projects in northwestern Tasmania. Established in 2020, it is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.

name: Carlton Precious Inc.
summary: Carlton Precious Inc., established in 2004, has its principal office in Toronto, Canada. It discovers and evaluates mineral resources, mainly gold, silver, copper and zinc, with exploration in several countries including Peru, Australia and the United States. It was previously named Nubian Resources Ltd. until a name change in 2024.

name: Copper Lake Resources Ltd.
summary: Copper Lake Resources Ltd. engages in the exploration, evaluation, and development of mineral properties in Canada. It explores for copper, zinc, silver, gold, nickel, cobalt, platinum, and palladium mineral properties. The company primarily focuses on the exploration and development of the Marshall Lake property that includes 44 mineral claims with an area of 8,864 hectares, as well as 89 mining leases with an area of 1,566.167 hectares for a total land position of 10,430.17 hectares situated north of Thunder Bay, Ontario; and the Norton Lake property that consists of 32 claims covering approximately 8,800 hectares located to the north of Thunder Bay, Ontario. It also has an option to acquire the Northwestern Ontario Gold properties, which comprise four properties situated in the Kenora and Patricia mining divisions in Northwestern Ontario. The company was formerly known as White Tiger Mining Corp. and changed its name to Copper Lake Resources Ltd. in September 2014. Copper Lake Resources Ltd. was incorporated in 1984 and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.

name: Allied Copper Corp.
summary: Allied Copper Corp. engages in the acquisition and development of mineral properties in the Western United States. It primarily explores for copper-gold assets. The company was formerly known as Gold Rush Cariboo Corp. and changed its name to Allied Copper Corp. in April 2021. Allied Copper Corp. is based in Toronto, Canada.

name: Canadian Premium Sand Inc.
summary: Canadian Premium Sand Inc., an exploration stage company, explores for and develops silica sand deposits. Its flagship project is the Wanipigow Sand Project consists of 41 contiguous quarry leases covering 2,148 hectares located to the North-East of Winnipeg, Manitoba. The company was formerly known as Claim Post Resources Inc. and changed its name to Canadian Premium Sand Inc. in November 2018. Canadian Premium Sand Inc. was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Calgary, Canada.

name: Conquest Resources Limited
summary: Conquest Resources Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the exploration, evaluation, and development of mineral properties in northern Ontario. It explores for gold properties. The company holds a 100% interest in the Belfast- TeckMag Property that consists of 27 mining leases and 33 staked mining claims located at Emerald Lake; Alexander property that consists of 27 patented claims covering 448 hectares situated in the Red Lake mining district; and Smith Lake property, which consists of 6 patented mining leases and 181 mining claims covering approximately 2,915 hectares located in the Missinabie-Goudreau greenstone belt, Ontario. It also owns an interest in the King Bay Property, which include one mining lease and 13 patented mining claims situated in Sturgeon Lake, Ontario. The company was incorporated in 1945 and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.

name: Cariboo Rose Resources Ltd.
summary: Cariboo Rose Resources Ltd., an exploration stage company, engages in the acquisition and exploration of mineral properties in Western Canada. The company explores for copper, gold, molybdenum, zinc, cobalt, and silver. It projects include the Lightning Strike, Pat, Cowtrail, Carruthers Pass, Coquigold, Koster Dam, and Carbonate Hosted Gold projects located in British Columbia. The company was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.

name: Carebook Technologies Inc.
summary: Carebook Technologies Inc., digital health company, develops digital health solutions. The company provides COVID-19 application and pharmacy engagement platform. It also offers virtual care and COVID-19 vital signs screening for pharmacies, insurance providers, individuals, governments, and businesses. The company is headquartered in Montreal, Canada.

name: Copper Road Resources Inc.
summary: Copper Road Resources Inc. acquires, explores and evaluates properties for mining precious and base metals in Canada. Formerly Stone Gold Inc., it took its current name in 2022. Incorporated in 2002, it is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.

name: Lithium Corporation
summary: Lithium Corporation, an exploration stage mining company, engages in the identification, acquisition, and exploration of metals and minerals in Nevada and British Columbia. It explores for lithium/boron/potassium, graphite, gold, and silver deposits. The company owns interests in the Fish Lake Valley property that includes 143 claims covering an area of approximately 11,360 acres located in northern Esmeralda County in west central Nevada; and San Emidio property comprising 10 claims, which cover an area of approximately 1,600 acres located in Washoe County in northwestern Nevada. It also holds interests in the BC Sugar Flake Graphite property covering an area 19,816 acres located in the Cherryville area of British Columbia; and Hughes claims located in the six discrete prospect areas of Nevada. The company was formerly known as Utalk Communications Inc. and changed its name to Lithium Corporation in September 2009. Lithium Corporation was incorporated in 2007 and is headquartered in Elko, Nevada.

name: Crossroads Gold Corp.
summary: Crossroads Gold Corp. is a gold exploration company focused on projects within a short drive of Melbourne in Victoria, Australia. Its projects include Steiglitz Gold, on one of Australia's earliest goldfields, and Pheasant Creek, which hosts underexplored quartz-veined diorite dykes with a strong gold-arsenic-antimony geochemical signature. It was founded in 2014.

name: Churchill Resources Inc.
summary: Churchill Resources Inc. is a Canadian mining-sector company exploring chiefly for nickel, copper and cobalt. Its projects include Taylor Brook in Newfoundland, Pelly Bay in Nunavut and White River in Ontario, with much of its effort directed to the Florence Lake project in Labrador.

name: Cortus Metals Inc.
summary: Cortus Metals Inc. engages in the evaluation, exploration, and production of mineral properties. The company explores for gold and other deposits. It holds an option to acquire a 100% interest in the Grayson, Powerline, and Goldrun properties located in Nevada. The company was incorporated in 2018 and is headquartered in Edmonton, Canada.

name: Cresval Capital Corp.
summary: Cresval Capital Corp., an exploration stage company, engages in the acquisition and exploration of base and precious metals in Canada. The company explores for copper, gold, molybdenum, and silver deposits. It owns interests in the Thunder Copper property that includes 13 contiguous mineral claims covering an area of approximately 11,127 hectares located to the west-northwest of Goldbridge, British Columbia; and the New Raven property, which consists of 6 mineral claims covering an area of 3,508 hectares located to the southwest of Lillooet, British Columbia. Cresval Capital Corp. was incorporated in 2001 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.

name: Crown Capital Partners Inc.
summary: Crown Capital Partners Inc. is a private equity firm specializing in acquisitions, special situations, management and leveraged buyouts, recapitalizations, mezzanine, bridge loans, and growth capital investments in private and public middle market companies. The firm also provides leveraged working capital loan and also invests in the form of royalties. It targets investments in companies based in Canada and select companies in the United States. It seeks to invest in all sectors. The firm typically makes investments between $1 million and $25 million in companies with sales value between $10 million and $200 million, enterprise value between $5 million and $200 million, and EBITDA between $2 million and $50 million. However, it may finance significantly larger transactions as well. The firm typically, invests in the form of subordinated debentures with or without equity participation rights as well as in unitranche debt with a single debt facility, combining senior and junior debt terms into a single senior debt facility. It also seeks to invest in distressed loans and acquires senior security position on the portfolio company's balance sheet. It makes equity investments in control buyout transactions. The firm seeks to exit its investments in less than five years. Crown Capital Partners Inc. was founded in 2000 and is based in Toronto, Canada with an additional office in Calgary, Canada.

name: Cosigo Resources Ltd.
summary: Cosigo Resources Ltd. is a junior explorer working to prove up gold in the Taraira District of south-eastern Colombia, close to the Brazilian frontier. Machado, Taraira South CN and Damian are among its projects. Its home office is in Victoria, Canada, and it was formed in December 1987.

name: Comstock Metals Ltd.
summary: Comstock Metals Ltd., a gold exploration company, engages in the acquisition and exploration of mineral properties in Canada and Mexico. It primarily explores gold deposits. The company holds a 100% interest in the Preview SW gold project comprises 853 hectares located in the La Ronge district of Saskatchewan. Comstock Metals Ltd. was incorporated in 2007 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.

name: Corsa Coal Corp.
summary: Corsa Coal Corp. operates as a coal mining company. It is involved in the mining, processing, and selling metallurgical coal; and exploring, acquiring, and developing resource properties. The company produces and sells low volatile metallurgical coal used for the production of coke from its mines located in the Northern Appalachia coal region of the United States. It serves steel and coke producers. The company markets and sells its coal to customers in North America, South America, Asia, and Europe. Corsa Coal Corp. is headquartered in Friedens, Pennsylvania.

name: Canso Select Opportunities Corporation
summary: Canso Select Opportunities Corporation is a publicly owned hedge fund manager. The firm invests in the public equity and fixed Income markets of Canada and across the globe. For fixed Income securities, the firm invests in governments, government agencies, bank loans, supranational agencies and companies. It conducts in-house research to make its investments. It is a private equity, venture capital and distressed firm specializing in investments focused in Canada. Canso Select Opportunities Corporation was founded on February 16, 2018 and is based in Richmond Hill, Canada.

summary: Canso Select Opportunities Corporation is a publicly owned hedge fund manager. The firm invests in the public equity and fixed Income markets of Canada and across the globe. name: CryptoStar Corp.
summary: CryptoStar Corp. provides infrastructure solutions in the blockchain industry in Canada, the United States, and Iceland. It engages in mining digital currencies activity. The company is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.

name: Clean Seed Capital Group Ltd.
summary: Clean Seed Capital Group Ltd. operates in the agriculture equipment industry in North America. It offers seeding and planting equipment. The company focuses on building the SMART Seeder MAX-S prototype and advancement of the related SMART Seeder technology. It is also involved in the software development business. The company was incorporated in 2010 and is headquartered in Burnaby, Canada.

name: CarbonTech Capital Corp.
summary: CarbonTech Capital Corp. is a company listed on the TSX Venture Exchange under the ticker CT-P and traded in CAD.

name: Centaurus Energy Inc.
summary: Centaurus Energy Inc., an independent upstream oil and gas company, explores, develops, and produces crude oil, natural gas liquids, and natural gas. The company holds approximately 950,000 net acres located in Argentina. Its primary producing concessions include Puesto Morales, Palmar Largo, and Surubi. The company was formerly known as Madalena Energy Inc. and changed its name to Centaurus Energy Inc. in September 2019. Centaurus Energy Inc. is based in Calgary, Alberta.

summary: Cleantek Industries, Inc. works in clean energy technology and earns revenue from selling equipment, renting it out and providing field services. It was founded in 2009 and has its head office in Calgary, Canada.

summary: CoTec Holdings Corp. acquires and develops mineral properties. It was founded in 1986 and has its head office in Vancouver, Canada.

name: Canterra Minerals Corporation
summary: Canterra Minerals Corporation, a resource company, engages in the evaluation, acquisition, and exploration of mineral properties in Canada and the United States. The company holds diamond properties in the Northwest Territories and Alberta, as well as focuses on gold exploration in Newfoundland. It also holds an option agreement to acquire a 100% interest in the East Alder gold project located in central Newfoundland. The company also holds interest in Wilding gold project covering an area of 23,600 hectares and Buffalo Hills property. The company was formerly known as Diamondex Resources Ltd. and changed its name to Canterra Minerals Corporation in December 2009. Canterra Minerals Corporation was incorporated in 1999 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.

name: Centurion Minerals Ltd.
summary: Centurion Minerals Ltd. procures, prospects for and develops mineral deposits in Canada and Argentina. A core part of its strategy is discovering, processing and selling calcium sulfate dihydrate, used both as fertilizer and as a conditioner for soil, distributed across Argentina, Paraguay, Bolivia, Brazil and Chile. Its principal undertaking is the Ana Sofia Agricultural Gypsum project in Argentina.

name: Circa Enterprises Inc.
summary: Circa Enterprises Inc. manufactures and supplies telecommunications and electrical products in the United States, Canada, and internationally. It operates in two segments, Telecommunications (Telecom) and Metal Fabrication (Metals). The Telecom segment offers surge protection products, ruggedized high-performance telecommunications equipment, and computer cables and related connectivity products under the CircaMax brand. The Metals segment provides enclosures, pole line hardware, and other products to the Canadian electrical industry under the Hydel brand. The company also designs, builds, and commissions PA/GA, page/talk, telephone, and talk/back paging systems; provides sheet metal fabrication services; and offers design and engineering/prototyping, fiber laser cutting, CNC brake press forming, and custom finishing services. Circa Enterprises Inc. was founded in 1985 and is headquartered in Calgary, Canada.

name: Edge Total Intelligence Inc.
summary: Edge Total Intelligence Inc. creates, promotes and distributes network management software for clients in the United States and internationally. Its main product, edgeCore, is a real-time digital operations platform that brings disparate data sources and software applications together in one interface, helping organizations improve operational efficiency in areas such as technology operations and automation.

name: CleanTech Vanadium Mining Corp.
summary: CleanTech Vanadium Mining Corp. is an exploration-stage mining company that acquires, explores and develops mineral properties in the United States and Bolivia, exploring for vanadium, lead, zinc, gold and nickel. Its flagship project is the wholly owned Gibellini vanadium project in Nevada. Formerly Flying Nickel Mining Corp., it was incorporated in 2020 and has its head office in Vancouver, Canada.

summary: County Capital 2 Ltd. intends to identify and evaluate businesses or assets with a view to complete the qualifying transaction. The company was incorporated in 2019 and is headquartered in Kelowna, Canada.

The company offers Cirreon Smart Safe, a cloud-based digital platform for managing networks of smart safes; Cash in Transit Logistics that manages routes, scans barcodes, and captures signatures digitally; and Deposit Tracking for tracking digital deposit data and transmits real-time updates. It also provides Online Change Orders for simplifying the change order process; and Currency Controller, a cash vault management and logistics system. It serves financial institutions, cash-in-transit industry, and banks and armored carriers. The company was formerly known as Cencotech Inc. and changed its name to NamSys Inc. in November 2016. NamSys Inc. was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.

name: CubicFarm Systems Corp.
summary: CubicFarm Systems Corp. develops, manufactures, and sells cubic farming systems for farmers worldwide. The company offers CubicFarm System and CubicFarms' HydroGreen System. Its systems help farmers to produce lettuce, basil, microgreens, nutraceutical ingredients, and animal feed. The company was formerly known as Forty Foot Farms Ltd. and changed its name to CubicFarms Systems Corp. in June 2016. CubicFarms Systems Corp was founded in 2015 and is based in Langley, Canada. CubicFarms Systems Corp was founded in 2015 and is headquartered in British Columbia, Canada.

summary: CopperEx Resources Corporation is a company listed on the TSX Venture Exchange under the ticker CUEX and traded in CAD.

summary: Currie Rose Resources Inc., an exploration stage company, acquires, explores for, and develops precious metal properties in Canada. The company primarily explores for gold, silver, and copper deposits. It holds an interest in the Rossland project, which covers an area of approximately 2,000 hectares located in British Columbia. The company was incorporated in 1973 and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.

summary: International Consolidated Uranium Inc. acquires, develops, explores for, and evaluates early stage mineral properties in Canada. It holds an 80% interest in the Mt. Roe gold project comprising two exploration blocks covering an area of approximately 1,235 hectares located in the Pilbara region in Western Australia; and the Dieter Lake property located in North-Central Quebec. The company also holds option agreements to acquire 100% interests in the Mountain Lake uranium property located in Nunavut, Canada; the Moran Lake project located in the Central Mineral Belt of Labrador, Canada; the Ben Lomond and Georgetown uranium projects located in Australia; the Laguna Salada project located in Chubut Province, Argentina; and 70% interest in the Kuulu property covering an area of 4,174 hectares located in the Kavilliq region of Nunavut, Canada. summary: Cornish Metals Inc. engages in the acquisition, evaluation, exploration, and development of mineral properties in North America and the United Kingdom. The company primarily explores for tin, tungsten, nickel, lithium, gold, copper, and cobalt deposits. Its flagship property is the South Crofty project comprising an underground mine permission area that covers 1,490 hectares located in the Central Mining District of Cornwall, the United Kingdom. The company was formerly known as Strongbow Exploration Inc. and changed its name to Cornish Metals Inc. in July 2020. Cornish Metals Inc. is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.

name: Copper Fox Metals Inc.
summary: Copper Fox Metals Inc., a resource company, engages in the exploration and development of copper mineral properties in Canada and the United States. Its principal asset is the Schaft Creek copper-gold-molybdenum-silver project located in northwestern British Columbia. The company also holds interest in the Eaglehead porphyry copper project located in northern British Columbia. Copper Fox Metals Inc. was incorporated in 2004 and is headquartered in Calgary, Canada.

name: Compass Gold Corporation
summary: Compass Gold Corporation engages in the acquisition, exploration, and development of mineral properties in Mali. The company primarily explores for gold deposits. It holds interests in the Sikasso property that consists of ten exploration permits covering an area of 867 square kilometers located in Mali, West Africa. The company, formerly known as Nordic Gold Corporation, was incorporated in 2002 and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.

name: Compass Venture Inc.
summary: Compass Venture Inc. is a capital pool company. The company intends to identify and evaluate businesses or assets with a view to complete a qualifying transaction. The company was incorporated in 2020 and is headquartered in Singapore.

name: CVR Medical Corp.
summary: CVR Medical Corp., a healthcare company, engages in the research and development of subsonic, infrasonic, and low frequency sound wave analysis technology for the healthcare sector. The company provides carotid stenotic scan device, a diagnostic tool to detect and measure carotid arterial stenosis. It offers its products for patients, payors, and healthcare providers. The company was formerly known as Big Bar Resources Corporation and changed its name to CVR Medical Corp. in September 2016. CVR Medical Corp. was incorporated in 1980 and is headquartered in North Vancouver, Canada.

name: CanAlaska Uranium Ltd.
summary: CanAlaska Uranium Ltd., an exploration stage company, engages in the acquisition and exploration of mineral properties. The company primarily explores for uranium, nickel, copper, gold, and diamond deposits. It holds interests in 15 projects covering an area of approximately 211,000 hectares of mining claims in the Athabasca region located across the provinces of Saskatchewan, Manitoba, British Columbia, and Alberta in Canada. The company was formerly known as CanAlaska Ventures Ltd. and changed its name to CanAlaska Uranium Ltd. in October 2006. CanAlaska Uranium Ltd. was founded in 1985 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.

Its proprietary Value from Waste technology is designed to pull water, minerals, solvents and bitumen out of oil sands tailings, and the firm also has interests in mining projects in the oil sands.

name: CEMATRIX Corporation
summary: CEMATRIX Corporation manufactures and supplies cellular concrete products for various applications in Canada and the United States. Its cellular concrete products are used in MSE wall, bridge approach backfill, roadways and runways, and slope stabilization; oil and gas facilities, shallow utilities, and contaminated site remediation; and tunnel grout, annular pipe grout, pipe abandonment, and flowable fills applications. CEMATRIX Corporation was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in Calgary, Canada.

name: CWC Energy Services Corp.
summary: CWC Energy Services Corp., a contract drilling and well servicing company, provides oilfield services to oil and gas exploration and development companies in the Western Canadian Sedimentary Basin. The company operates through two segments, Contract Drilling and Production Services. It offers oilfield services, including drilling rigs, service rigs, and swabbing rigs. The company also provides completion, maintenance, workover, and well decommissioning services. It operates through a fleet of 9 telescopic double drilling rigs with depth ratings from 3,200 to 5,000 meters; 145 service rigs, including 75 single, 56 double, and 14 slant rigs; and 12 swabbing rigs. The company was formerly known as CWC Well Services Corp. and changed its name to CWC Energy Services Corp. in May 2014. CWC Energy Services Corp. is headquartered in Calgary, Canada.

name: CurrencyWorks Inc.
summary: CurrencyWorks Inc. provides turnkey set of services for companies to develop and integrate blockchain and cryptocurrency technologies into their business operations. Its services include business development and technical; blockchain and technology program management comprises product vision and road-mapping, program development and project management, and product development and testing; customer development, such as customer discovery and scoping and product commercialization and support; business launch; and post-business launch support services. The company was formerly known as ICOx Innovations Inc. and changed its name to CurrencyWorks Inc. in September 2019. CurrencyWorks Inc. was incorporated in 2010 and is based in Los Angeles, California.

name: Crown Point Energy, Inc.
summary: Crown Point Energy Inc., a junior international oil and gas company, engages in the exploration for, and development and production of petroleum and natural gas properties. It holds a portfolio of projects located in Argentina. The company was formerly known as Crown Point Ventures Ltd. and changed its name to Crown Point Energy Inc. in July 2012. The company was incorporated in 1966 and is based in Calgary, Canada. Crown Point Energy Inc. is a subsidiary of Liminar Energia S.A.

name: Crown Point Energy Inc.
summary: Crown Point Energy Inc., a junior oil and gas company, explores for, develops, and produces petroleum and natural gas properties in Argentina. The company holds 100% working interest in the Cerro de Los Leones concession permit covering an area of 100,907 acres located in the northern portion of the Neuquén Basin in the province of Mendoza, Argentina. It also holds interests in the Las Violetas, La Angostura, and Rio Cullen exploitation concessions covering a total area of approximately 489,000 acres in the Austral Basin of Tierra del Fuego. The company was formerly known as Crown Point Ventures Ltd. and changed its name to Crown Point Energy Inc. in July 2012. Crown Point Energy Inc. was incorporated in 1966 and is based in Calgary, Canada. The company is a subsidiary of Liminar Energia S.A.

name: CyberCatch Holdings, Inc.
summary: CyberCatch Holdings, Inc. is a cyber security company offering an AI-enabled software-as-a-service platform. The platform helps a business put in place baseline cyber security controls aligned with a framework, standard or regulation, then continuously and automatically tests them to detect deficiencies and non-compliance so the business can fix them and regain compliance.

name: Canyon Creek Food Company Ltd.
summary: Canyon Creek Food Company Ltd. operates as a food processing company in Canada. It offers fresh soups, stews and chilies, sauces, mashed potatoes, and gravies, as well as other prepared food products. The company provides its products to grocery retailers and a range of food service establishments, such as restaurants and institutions. Canyon Creek Food Company Ltd. was founded in 1996 and is based in Edmonton, Canada.

name: Cygnus Metals Limited
summary: Cygnus Metals Limited explores for gold in the Southwest Terrane of the Yilgarn Craton in Western Australia, with projects named Pontax, Auclair and Sakami. Amanda Buckingham and Oliver Pierre Kreuzer founded it on November 3, 2015, and it is based in West Perth.

name: Ceylon Graphite Corp.
summary: Ceylon Graphite Corp. engages in the exploration and production of graphite mines in Sri Lanka. The company holds a land package of approximately 120 square kilometers grids containing vein graphite deposits. Ceylon Graphite Corp. is based in Vancouver, Canada.

name: Cymat Technologies Ltd.
summary: Cymat Technologies Ltd., a materials technology company, manufactures and sells stabilized aluminum foam products worldwide. It provides architectural materials under the Alusion brand name; and automotive and blast mitigation products under the SmartMetal brand name. The company holds three projects where work is being completed under an earn-in agreement from third parties that include the Frotet and Chicobi projects, which are both located in Quebec, Canada, as well as option to acquire interest in the Chebistuan Project, located in Quebec. It also owns 100% of the advanced stage Tanacross porphyry Cu-Au project, as well as an option to earn up to 70% in the Healy Project, both located in Alaska, the United States. Kenorland Minerals Ltd. was founded in 2016 and is based in Vancouver, Canada.

name: Kirkland Lake Discoveries Corp.
summary: Kirkland Lake Discoveries Corp. procures, investigates and appraises mineral properties in Canada, seeking gold, silver, copper, zinc and diamonds. Originally known as Warrior Gold Inc., it was founded in 1984 and does business principally from Vancouver, Canada.

name: Kermode Resources Ltd.
summary: Kermode Resources Ltd. engages in the acquisition, exploration, and development of natural resource properties in Canada. It holds 15% interests in Eastgate Gold property located northeast of the Rawhide Mine, and east of Fallon in Churchill, County, Nevada. The company also entered into an option agreement to acquire a 100% interest in the Vidette Lake gold project in British Columbia. Kermode Resources Ltd. is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.

name: KGL Resources Ltd
summary: KGL Resources Ltd. does not have significant operations. The company was previously engaged in the acquisition, exploration, and evaluation of gold mineral resource properties. It was formerly known as Kilo Goldmines Ltd. and changed its name to KGL Resources Ltd. in March 2021. The company was incorporated in 2006 and is based in Toronto, Canada.

name: OrganiMax Nutrient Corp.
summary: OrganiMax Nutrient Corp., an exploration stage company, engages in the acquisition, exploration, and development of mineral properties in Canada, Mexico, and internationally. It explores for lithium, potassium, and boron deposits. The company holds 100% interests in the Zacatecas-San Luis Potosi project located in central Mexico; and the Coahuila Salar project located in northern Mexico. Its properties cover approximately 424,000 hectares. The company was formerly known as Alset Minerals Corp. and changed its name to OrganiMax Nutrient Corp. in August 2018. OrganiMax Nutrient Corp. was incorporated in 2003 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.

name: K9 Gold Corp.
summary: K9 Gold Corp. engages in the identification, acquisition, and exploration of mineral interests. It holds 100% interests in the Stony Lake East Gold project consisting of 8 mineral licenses covering an area of 13,625 hectares located in the Grand Falls province of Newfoundland. The company also owns interests in the Desert Eagle project comprising 97 claims covering an area of 2,004 acres located in Garfield County, Utah, the United States. The company was formerly known as Global Vanadium Corp. and changed its name to K9 Gold Corp. in September 2020. K9 Gold Corp. was incorporated in 2007 and is based in Vancouver, Canada.

name: Kane Biotech Inc.
summary: Kane Biotech Inc., a biotechnology company, engages in the research, development, and commercialization of technologies and products that prevent and remove microbial biofilms in Canada and internationally. The company develops pet oral care products under the StrixNB and bluestem brands; animal and human wound care solutions under the DispersinB name; medical device coatings under the Aledex name; and shampoos for dogs, cats, and horses under the Alosera name. It also offers anti-itch shampoo under the silkstem name; scalp detoxifiers, shampoos, and shampoo bars under the DermaKB Biofilm brand name; and wound care products under the Coactiv+ name. The company was incorporated in 2001 and is based in Winnipeg, Canada.

name: Kingsmen Resources Ltd.
summary: Kingsmen Resources Ltd., a junior mineral exploration company, engages in the acquisition and exploration of precious metals on mineral properties. It explores for silver, gold, and tellurium deposits. It holds a 51% interest in La Trini project consisting of five mineral claims located in northwest of Guadalajara in Jalisco State, Mexico. The company was formerly known as Tumi Resources Limited and changed its name to Kingsmen Resources Ltd. in July 2015. Kingsmen Resources Ltd. was incorporated in 2000 and is based in Vancouver, Canada.

name: Vault Strategic Mining Corp.
summary: Vault Strategic Mining Corp., based in Burnaby, Canada, and founded in 2011, identifies and develops mineral resource properties in Canada. A notable asset is the Letain nickel project, over which it holds an option to take complete ownership. It was formerly Margaret Lake Diamonds Inc.

name: Kiaro Holdings Corp.
summary: Kiaro Holdings Corp. owns and operates cannabis retail stores in Canada. It also sells through online. The company was founded in 2019 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.

name: KORE Mining Ltd.
summary: KORE Mining Ltd. engages in the exploration, development, and evaluation of mineral resource properties. It primary focuses on two 100% owned gold projects, including the Imperial project that consists of 654 claims covering an area of approximately 5,721 acres located in Imperial County, southeastern California; and the Long Valley gold development project, which comprises 95 mining claims that cover an area of approximately 1,800 acres located in Mono County, east-central California. The company is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.

name: Kovo+ Holdings Inc.
summary: Kovo+ Holdings Inc. is a company listed on the TSX Venture Exchange under the ticker KOVO and traded in CAD.

name: KP3993 Resources Inc.
summary: KP3993 Resources Inc. is a company listed on the TSX Venture Exchange under the ticker KPEN-P and traded in CAD.

name: Kobo Resources Inc.
summary: Kobo Resources Inc. acquires, explores and develops gold properties in West Africa through a subsidiary, focusing on the Kossou Gold and Kotobi projects. Edouard Gosselin and Paul Thomson Sarjeant founded it on December 14, 2015, and it is headquartered in Quebec.

name: Kainantu Resources Ltd.
summary: Kainantu Resources Limited operates as a gold exploration company. The company is based in Lae, Papua New Guinea.

name: Koryx Copper S.A.
summary: Koryx Copper S.A. is a mineral exploration company that acquires, explores and develops mineral properties. It reports Canada, Namibia, Zambia and Mauritius geographic segments, and its projects include Haib Copper and Kapili Tepe. Founded in 1987, it is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.

name: Klondike Silver Corp.
summary: Klondike Silver Corp., a resource exploration stage company, engages in the acquisition and exploration of mineral properties. It primarily explores for silver, lead, and zinc deposits. The company primarily owns a 100% interest in the Slocan Silver camp that covers an area of approximately 116 square kilometers located in South Eastern British Columbia. It also holds interests in mineral claims located in the Horwood Township of the Porcupine mining division, Ontario; and Yukon property. Klondike Silver Corp. was incorporated in 2005 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.

name: kneat.com, inc.
summary: kneat.com, inc. designs, develops, and supplies software for data and document management within regulated environments in the United States, Ireland, Canada, internationally. The company offers Kneat Gx platform, a configurable commercial off-the-shelf application focused on validation lifecycle management and testing for biotechnology, pharmaceutical, and medical device manufacturing industries. Its platform is used in instrument, method, utility and facility, process, equipment, computer system, cold chain, and cleaning validation, as well commissioning and qualification, and electronic logbook management. It also provides software-related services, including training, installation, upgradation, consulting, and maintenance, as well as process mapping, project management, and other services. The company is headquartered in Limerick, Ireland.

name: Alset Capital Inc.
summary: Alset Capital Inc. invests in the sports technology sector. It also provides hockey coaching services. The company was formerly known as ProSmart Enterprises Inc. and changed its name to Alset Capital Inc. in February 2021. Alset Capital Inc. is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.

name: Kootenay Silver Inc.
summary: Kootenay Silver Inc., an exploration stage company, engages in the acquisition, exploration, and development of mineral properties Mexico and Canada. The company explores for silver, gold, lead, and zinc ores. It primarily holds interests in the La Cigarra silver project covering approximately 18,000 hectares located within the Parral Mining District in the state of Chihuahua, north central Mexico; Promontorio and La Negra silver discoveries situated in Sonora, Mexico; Columba Silver project located in Chihuahua, Mexico; and Copalito Silver-gold project located in Sinaloa, Mexico. The company was formerly known as Kootenay Gold Inc. and changed its name to Kootenay Silver Inc. in February 2012. Kootenay Silver Inc. is based in Vancouver, Canada.

name: K2 Gold Corp
summary: K2 Gold Corporation, a junior mineral exploration company, acquires, explores for, and evaluates gold exploration projects in Canada and the United States. The company primarily explores for gold and silver deposits. It has an option to acquire a 100% interest in its flagship Mojave Gold project that covers an area of approximately 5,830 hectares located in California. The company was formerly known as West Melville Metals Inc. and changed its name to K2 Gold Corporation in November 2016. K2 Gold Corporation was incorporated in 2011 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.

name: Kintavar Exploration Inc.
summary: Kintavar Exploration Inc. engages in the acquisition, assessment, exploration, and development of gold and base metal mineral properties in Canada. Its flagship project is the 100% owned Mitchi copper property that covers approximately 30,083 hectares located in the north-western portion of the central metasedimentary belt of the Grenville geological province. The company was founded in 2017 and is headquartered in Boucherville, Canada.

name: Kootenay Resources Inc.
summary: Kootenay Resources Inc. is an exploration-stage mining company exploring and developing mineral properties in Canada, mainly for gold, silver, zinc, lead and copper. Its flagship property is the Moyie Anticline Project in British Columbia. It was incorporated in 2006 and has its base in Vancouver, Canada.

name: Kua Investments Inc.
summary: Kua Investments Inc. is a company listed on the TSX Venture Exchange under the ticker KUAI-P and traded in CAD.

name: Cub Energy Inc.
summary: CUB Energy Inc., an upstream oil and gas company, engages in the exploration and development of onshore oil and gas properties. As of December 31, 2019, it had nine licenses with approximately 142,000 net acres in Ukraine. The company is headquartered in Houston, Texas.

name: Kure Technologies, Inc.
summary: Kure Technologies, Inc. does not have significant operations. Previously, the company, through its subsidiary, Look Communications Inc., provided digital television broadcasting services to residential and business subscribers. The company was formerly known as Unique Broadband Systems, Inc. and changed its name to Kure Technologies, Inc. in March 2017. Kure Technologies, Inc. was incorporated in 1998 and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.

name: RediShred Capital Corp.
summary: RediShred Capital Corp., together with its subsidiaries, manages and operates the Proshred brand and business platform in the United States and internationally. The company operates in three segments: Franchising and licensing, Corporate Locations, and Corporate Overhead. The company grants and manages shredding business franchises under the Proshred trademark; operates in corporate shredding businesses; and supports the franchises. RediShred Capital Corp. was founded in 2006 and is headquartered in Mississauga, Canada.

name: Kuuhubb Inc.
summary: Kuuhubb Inc., through its subsidiaries, operates as a mobile game development and publishing company. It creates games and applications for female audience with a focus on relaxation, expression, and entertainment segments. The company offers Recolor, a digital coloring book application. It also develops Neybers, an interior design game application; My Hospital, a simulation game application; Dance Talent, a mobile game application; and Tiles & Tales game in a new story-based format. Kuuhubb Inc. markets its products through various third-party platforms. The company was formerly known as Delrand Resources Limited and changed its name to KuuHubb Inc. in June 2017. Kuuhubb Inc. is based in Toronto, Canada.

name: KWESST Micro Systems Inc.
summary: KWESST Micro Systems Inc. develops and commercializes miniaturized technology applications for defense and security industries. The company offers products, such as TASCSTM (Tactical and Situational Control System) for real-time awareness and targeting information from any source; the autonomous GreyGhost soldier-portable micro drone missile system that defends against small hostile drones, including swarms; the Ground Laser Defence System to counter the emerging threat of weaponized lasers against personnel; the Phantom electronic battlefield decoy system to mask the electromagnetic signature of friendly forces with decoy signatures at false locations to deceive and confuse adversaries; and Smart Ordnance System. KWESST Micro Systems Inc. is headquartered in Ottawa, Canada.

name: Kaymus Resources Inc.
summary: Kaymus Resources Inc. engages in the exploration, acquisition, and development of petroleum and natural gas projects in the Western Canadian Sedimentary Basin. It holds 100% interest in two oil locations, located near the town of Sylvian Lake, Alberta. The company was formerly known as Cascadia Resources Inc. and changed its name to Kaymus Resources Inc. in July 2014. Kaymus Resources Inc. was incorporated in 1983 and is based in Calgary, Canada.

name: Kaizen Discovery Inc.
summary: Kaizen Discovery Inc. explores for and develops mineral projects in Peru and Canada. It holds interest in the Pinaya Copper-Gold Project that covers an area of 100.65 square kilometers and includes 10 kilometers of underexplored strike length within the Andahuaylas-Yauri Porphyry-Skarn Belt in southeastern Peru. The company is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada. As of December 31, 2019, Kaizen Discovery Inc. operates as a subsidiary of HPX TechCo Inc.

name: Los Andes Copper Ltd.
summary: Los Andes Copper Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, acquires, explores, and develops copper deposits in the Americas. It operates through Mineral Exploration and Hydroelectric Project segments. The company holds 100% interest in the Vizcachitas copper, molybdenum, and silver porphyry project located to the north of Santiago, Region V, Chile. It is also involved in the development of a hydroelectric project. Los Andes Copper Ltd. was incorporated in 1983 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.

name: Labrador Gold Corp
summary: Labrador Gold Corp. engages in the acquisition, exploration, and development of gold properties in the Americas. The company owns a 100% interest in the Borden Lake property that covers an area of 1,598-hectares located in Chapleau, Ontario. It has an option to acquire 100% interest in the Ashuanipi property consisting of 1,564 Claims in 10 claim blocks covering an area of approximately 391 square kilometers located in Labrador, Quebec; the Kingsway property consisting of 264 claims in 3 licenses covering approximately 77 square kilometers located near Gander, Newfoundland; and the Hopedale property that comprises 998 claims in 5 licenses covering 249 square kilometers. The company was formerly known as Nikos Explorations Ltd. and changed its name to Labrador Gold Corp. in December 2017. Labrador Gold Corp. was incorporated in 1987 and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.

name: New Carolin Gold Corp.
summary: New Carolin Gold Corp., a junior-stage exploration and mine development company, engages in the acquisition, exploration, evaluation, and development of various gold properties in Canada. The company holds a 100% interest in the Ladner Gold project comprises 144 square kilometers located in the Coquihalla Gold Belt in Southwestern British Columbia. It also has an option to acquire Warkentin property consisting of 20 mineral claims covering 30 square kilometers situated near the southern portion of the Ladner Gold project. The company was formerly known as Module Resources Incorporated and changed its name to New Carolin Gold Corp. in October 2011. New Carolin Gold Corp. was incorporated in 1981 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.

name: Lithium Africa Corp.
summary: Lithium Africa Corp. acquires, develops and operates lithium properties. It was founded in 2024 and has its head office in George Town, Cayman Islands.

name: Latam Lithium Corp.
summary: Latam Lithium Corp., founded in 2011 and based in Vancouver, acquires and explores mineral properties in Canada and Argentina, mainly seeking gold and lithium. It was previously called Portofino Resources Inc.

name: Libero Copper & Gold Corporation
summary: Libero Copper & Gold Corporation engages in the acquisition, exploration, and development of mineral properties in Canada, the United States, and Colombia. The company has an option to acquire a 100% interest in the Tomichi porphyry copper-molybdenum deposit located in the Tomichi Mining District, Gunnison County, Southwestern Colorado; the Big Bulk Porphyry Gold-Copper property located in British Columbia, Canada; and the Big Red porphyry copper-gold property comprising 20 contiguous claims covering an area of 26,000 hectares in northwestern British Columbia. It also owns 100% interest in the Mocoa porphyry copper-molybdenum deposit located in the Eastern Cordillera of Colombia. The company was formerly known as Libero Copper Corporation and changed its name to Libero Copper & Gold Corporation in September 2019. Libero Copper & Gold Corporation was incorporated in 2008 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.

name: Lions Bay Capital Inc.
summary: Lions Bay Capital Inc., an investment holding company, focuses on acquiring strategic stakes in companies operating in the resource, energy, and resource related technology sectors. The company is based in Vancouver, Canada.

name: Lattice Biologics Ltd.
summary: Lattice Biologics Ltd., a biotech company, develops, manufactures, and markets biologic products for use in the field of bone regeneration in dental, spine, and general orthopedic indications worldwide. It develops novel amniotic fluid-based products, such as AmnioBoost and AmnioBlast. The company also offers traditional, spinal, particulate, soft tissue, dental, membrane and barrier, and demineralized bone matrix allografts. Its products are used in a range of applications, including enhancing fusion in spine surgery and breast reconstruction post mastectomy, promotion of bone regeneration in foot and ankle surgery, promotion of skull healing following neurosurgery, enhancing wound repair in burn victims, hernia repair, and subchondral bone defect repair in knee and other joint surgeries, as well as sports medicine indications, such as anterior and posterior cruciate ligament repair. The company is headquartered in Belgrade, Montana.

name: LithiumBank Resources Corp.
summary: LithiumBank Resources Corp., established in 2019 and based in Vancouver, explores and develops lithium-brine assets in Canada. Its properties lie in Alberta and Saskatchewan and include Boardwalk, Swan Hills, Kakwa, Valhalla, Fox Creek, Estevan and Kindersley, among others.

name: Century Lithium Corp.
summary: Century Lithium Corp. acquires, explores, assesses and advances mineral resource properties in the United States, mainly lithium. It holds full interests in several Nevada assets in the Clayton Valley area, including the Clayton Valley project and the Dean and Glory lithium properties, plus the Gunman Project and an interest in the Enertopia Project. It was formed in 1991.

name: Lycos Energy Inc.
summary: Lycos Energy Inc. explores for, develops and produces oil. It operates heavy-oil and development assets near Gull Lake in southwest Saskatchewan and heavy-oil assets near Lloydminster. Founded on May 8, 2006, it is headquartered in Calgary.

name: Lithoquest Resources Inc.
summary: Lithoquest Resources Inc. engages in the acquisition, exploration, and development of mining properties. It holds a 100% interest in the North Kimberley diamond project located in the King George River region of Western Australia. The company was formerly known as Lithoquest Diamonds Inc. and changed its name to Lithoquest Resources Inc. in November 2020. Lithoquest Resources Inc. is headquartered in Salt Spring Island, Canada.

name: Quantum Critical Metals Corp.
summary: Quantum Critical Metals Corp. is a Canadian company that secures and develops mineral resource properties, exploring for copper, zinc, rubidium, cesium, niobium, gallium, rare earths, antimony and gold. It began in 2006 as Durango Resources Inc. and is headquartered in Richmond, Canada.

name: Legacy Gold Mines Ltd.
summary: Legacy Gold Mines Ltd. is a Calgary-based Canadian gold exploration and development company, founded on June 4, 2021. It holds an option to acquire an undivided interest in the mineral claims of the Baner Gold Mine Property in Idaho County, Idaho.

name: Leading Edge Materials Corp.
summary: Leading Edge Materials Corp. explores for and develops a portfolio of raw material projects in Europe. The company primarily explores for graphite, lithium, nickel, cobalt, and rare earth elements. It holds a 100% interest in the Woxna graphite project that comprises four concessions consisting of Kringelgruven, Mattsmyra, Gropabo, and Mansberg located in Gavleborg County, central Sweden. The company also holds interests in the Norra Karr HREE project located in south-central Sweden; Bergby lithium project, which consists of three exploration permits located in central Sweden; and a 51% interest in the Bihor Sud nickel cobalt exploration alliance located in Romania. The company was formerly known as Flinders Resources Limited and changed its name to Leading Edge Materials Corp. in August 2016. Leading Edge Materials Corp. is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.

name: Lithium Energi Exploration Inc.
summary: Lithium Energi Exploration Inc. engages in the acquisition, exploration, and development of lithium brine assets in Argentina. It holds interest in the Laguna Caro project covering approximately 17,759 hectares; the Antofalla North project covering approximately 41,496 hectares; and the Antofalla South project covering 69,112 hectares in Argentina. The company was formerly known as Portola Resources Inc. and changed its name to Lithium Energi Exploration Inc. in March 2017. Energi Exploration, Inc. was incorporated in 1998 and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.

name: Left Field Capital Corp.
summary: Left Field Capital Corp. is a company listed on the TSX Venture Exchange under the ticker LFC-P and traded in CAD.

name: Lifeist Wellness Inc.
summary: Lifeist Wellness Inc., headquartered in Vancouver, Canada, and established in 2005, is a wellness company operating in the United States and Canada that was formerly Namaste Technologies Inc. Its holdings include CannMart.com, an online store for hemp-derived CBD and accessories, Findify, an AI-powered personalised search and analytics platform for B2B e-commerce clients, and a facility that extracts butane hash oil.

name: Lahontan Gold Corp.
summary: Lahontan Gold Corp. is a mineral exploration company holding three exploration projects for gold and silver in Nevada's Walker Lane. It was founded in 2020 by Kimberly Ann Arntson and Brian J. Maher and has its head office in Toronto, Canada.

name: Lavras Gold Corp.
summary: Lavras Gold Corp. is a Toronto-based junior exploration company, founded in 2021, working in southern Brazil. Its main project is the Lavras do Sul gold project, a concession of about 22,000 hectares in Rio Grande do Sul state.

name: Logan Energy Corp.
summary: Logan Energy Corp. is a Calgary oil and gas company that explores, develops and produces. It holds interests in northwest Alberta (Simonette and Pouce Coupe) and in northeastern British Columbia (Flatrock). It was incorporated in 2023 as 2499938 Alberta Ltd. and changed names that March.

name: Lendified Holdings Inc.
summary: Lendified Holdings Inc., through its subsidiaries, provides online lending services for small businesses and lending technology to financial institutions in North America. It operates in two segments, Lending and Software as a Service (SaaS). The Lending segment originates and retains loans as part of its loans receivable portfolio. The SaaS segment engages in the sale of subscriptions for use of its web-based software. The company offers business loans for refinancing, cash flow, inventory and sourcing, bill and supplier, payment, equipment, relocation and expansion, hiring and training, and advertising and promotion activities. It serves the retail, auto related, health and beauty, restaurant, construction, and various other industries. Lendified Holdings Inc. was founded in 2015 and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.

name: Lakeview Hotel Investment Corp.
summary: Lakeview Hotel Investment Corp is listed on the TSX Venture Exchange under the symbol "LHR". Lakeview Hotel Investment Corp received income from ownership, management and licensing of hotel properties.

name: American Lithium Corp.
summary: American Lithium Corp., an exploration stage company, engages in the identification, acquisition, exploration, and development of resource properties in the United States. The company primarily explores for lithium and vanadium. It primarily focuses on the Tonopah Claystone Claims Property covering an area of approximately 4,000 acres located in the town of Tonopah, Nevada. The company was formerly known as Menika Mining Ltd. and changed its name to American Lithium Corp. in April 2016. American Lithium Corp. was incorporated in 1974 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.

name: LibertyStream Infrastructure Partners Inc.
summary: LibertyStream Infrastructure Partners Inc. is a Calgary-based lithium development and technology company in North America. It extracts lithium from oilfield brines and refines lithium carbonate, and holds interests in the Permian and Bakken basins.

name: Li-FT Power Ltd.
summary: Li-FT Power Ltd. is a mineral exploration company that acquires, explores and develops lithium-rich pegmatite deposits in Canada. The wholly owned Yellowknife Lithium Project in the Northwest Territories is its most significant holding, and it has stakes in other regional lithium projects including DeStaffany, LDG and Mackay. Founded in 2021, it is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.

name: Little Fish Acquisition I Corp.
summary: Little Fish Acquisition I Corp. is a company listed on the TSX Venture Exchange under the ticker LILL-P and traded in CAD.

name: Lion One Metals Limited
summary: Lion One Metals Limited engages in mine development and exploration of mineral properties in Fiji. Its primary asset is the 100% owned Tuvatu Gold project, which comprise four exploration licenses located on the island of Viti Levu in Fiji. The company is headquartered in North Vancouver, Canada.

name: Lithium South Development Corporation
summary: Lithium South Development Corporation, an exploration stage junior mining company, engages in the identification, acquisition, and exploration of mineral properties. Its flagship property is the Hombre Muerto North lithium brine project covering approximately 3,287 hectares in 6 mining concessions located in Salta Province, Argentina. The company was formerly known as NRG Metals Inc. and changed its name to Lithium South Development Corporation in November 2020. Lithium South Development Corporation was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.

name: Argentina Lithium & Energy Corp.
summary: Argentina Lithium & Energy Corp., a junior mineral exploration company, engages in the acquisition, exploration, and evaluation of natural resource properties in Argentina. It holds a 100% interest in the Incahuasi lithium project covering an area of approximately 25,500 hectares of granted mineral rights properties located in the Catamarca Province, Argentina. The company was formerly known as Iron South Mining Corp. and changed its name to Argentina Lithium & Energy Corp. in September 2016. Argentina Lithium & Energy Corp. was incorporated in 2000 and is based in Vancouver, Canada.

name: Lithium Chile Inc.
summary: Lithium Chile Inc. engages in the acquisition and development of mining properties in Chile. The company explores for gold, silver, and copper deposits. It holds interests in a lithium property portfolio consisting of 71,900 hectares of exploration claims; and a copper-gold property portfolio comprising approximately 22,429 hectares of exploration claims. The company was formerly known as Kairos Capital Corporation and changed its name to Lithium Chile Inc. in December 2017. Lithium Chile Inc. was incorporated in 2010 and is headquartered in Calgary, Canada.

name: FutureGen Industries Corp.
summary: Roadman Investments Corp. is a venture capital, private equity and advisory firm specializing in incubation, seed, start-ups, later stage, strategic advisory, global partnership development, breakthrough products, devices, treatments, health supplement, corporate restructuring, Corporate recapitalization and growth capital investments. It focuses on managing and facilitating foreign investment and investing in private and public companies whose businesses involve later-stage. The firm prefers to invest in health & wellness, agricultural, medicinal mushroom, media, retail, financial services, pharmaceutical products, nutrition, medicine, technology, healthcare, clean tech, energy, consumer product, and consumer services and identify an exit strategy in China or North America. The firm invests into companies across the Pan-Pacific region. It prefers to take majority stake in its portfolio companies. Roadman Investments Corp. is previously known as Urban Select Capital Corporation and formerly known as China Select Capital Partners Corp, was incorporated in September 12, 2007 and is based in Vancouver, Canada with an additional office in Beijing, China, Vancouver, Canada.

name: Lucky Minerals Inc.
summary: Lucky Minerals Inc. engages in the acquisition, exploration, and evaluation of mineral properties. The company explores for gold, copper, and molybdenum deposits. It holds a 100% interest in the Fortuna project covering an area of 550 square kilometer comprising of 12 contiguous mining concessions located in southern Ecuador. The company also holds an option to acquire 100% interests the Emigrant Creek project, which covers an area of 15 square kilometer situated in southern Montana, the United States; and the St. Julien project located in Montana, the United States. The company was incorporated in 2007 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.

name: Canada Rare Earth Corp.
summary: Canada Rare Earth Corp., a development stage company, engages in the exploration and development of rare earth elements in North America and Asia. Its products include high-purity rare earth oxides, rare earth fluorides, larger particle/nano rare earth oxides, and other products. The company was formerly known as Rare Earth Metals Inc. and changed its name to Canada Rare Earth Corp. in February 2013. Canada Rare Earth Corp. was incorporated in 1987 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.

name: Mason Graphite Inc.
summary: Mason Graphite Inc., a mining and processing company, engages in the acquisition, exploration, evaluation, and development of mineral properties in Canada. It primarily owns a 100% interest in the Lac Guéret graphite property, which consists of 215 claims covering an area of 11,630 hectares located in northeastern Quebec. The company was incorporated in 2011 and is headquartered in Laval, Canada.

name: Lingo Media Corporation
summary: Lingo Media Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, develops, markets, and supports a suite of English language learning solutions in the People's Republic of China. The company operates in two segments, License of Intellectual Property, and Online and Offline Language Learning. The License of Intellectual Property segment publishes print-based English language learning textbook programs. It co-publishes approximately 708 million units from library of program titles. The Online English Language Learning segment provides Web-based educational technology English language learning, training, and assessment solutions, such as Web-based software licensing subscriptions, online and professional services, audio practice tools, and multi-platform applications. It offers approximately 3,000 hours of interactive learning through various product offerings that include Winnie's World, English Academy, Campus, English for Success, and Master and business. This segment also markets its products in Latin America, Asia, Europe, and the United States through a network of distributors. Lingo Media Corporation is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.

name: Laurion Mineral Exploration Inc.
summary: Laurion Mineral Exploration Inc. engages in the acquisition, exploration, and development of gold properties in Canada. The company explores for gold, silver, zinc, copper, and base metal deposits. Its flagship project is the Ishkoday property covering an area of 4,442 hectares of land package covering 6 properties consisting of 20 mining leases totaling 1,178 hectares and 18 mining claims totaling 3,264 hectares located in Irwin, Pifher, Walters, and Elmhirst townships to the northeast of the town of Beardmore. The company was formerly known as Laurion Gold Inc. and changed its name to Laurion Mineral Exploration Inc. in October 2006. Laurion Mineral Exploration Inc. was incorporated in 1945 and is based in Toronto, Canada.

name: Lincoln Gold Mining Inc.
summary: Lincoln Gold Mining Inc. engages in the acquisition, exploration, and evaluation of mineral properties. It holds interests in the Pine Grove gold property with mining leases on the Wilson and Wheeler mines, and 243 unpatented claims located in the Pine Grove Hills, Lyon County, Nevada. The company also holds claims in the pre-development stage Oro Cruz gold property that consists of 151 lode claims covering an area of approximately 3,000 acres located in Imperial County, California. In addition, it has an option to acquire 100% interest in the Shawinigan property consists of 21 contiguous mineral claims covering an area of 12.4 square kilometers located in Shawinigan Township, Montreal. The company was formerly known as Lincoln Mining Corporation and changed its name to Lincoln Gold Mining Inc. in September 2019. Lincoln Gold Mining Inc. is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.

name: Le Mare Gold Corp.
summary: Le Mare Gold Corp., a resource exploration company, acquires and explores for mineral properties in Canada. It has an option to acquire a 100% interest in Brussels Creek property comprises 17 claims covering 1350.43 hectares located in the Kamloops Mining District, British Columbia. The company was formerly known as Southern Lithium Corp. and changed its name to Le Mare Gold Corp. in February 2018. Le Mare Gold Corp. was incorporated in 2010 and is based in North Vancouver, Canada.

name: Lumine Group
summary: Lumine Group, Inc. acquires, strengthens and grows communications & media software businesses.
