Its principal project is the Calcatreu project located in south central Rio Negro Province. The company also holds interests in Lomada gold deposit; La Manchuria project; La Josefina project; and Martha Mill property. It holds an option to acquire a 100% interest in the Mina Angela property located in the Province of Chubut, Argentina. In addition the company's exploration projects comprise Tornado and Huracán, Sarita, Los Toldo, El Gateado, Bajo Pobre project, and La Valenciana. Patagonia Gold Corp. is headquartered in Buenos Aires, Argentina.

name: Stillwater Critical Minerals Corp.
summary: Group Ten Metals Inc., a mineral exploration company, engages in the acquisition, exploration, and development of mineral properties in Canada and the United States. The company explores for gold, platinum, palladium, nickel, copper, cobalt, and other commodities. Its core asset is the 100%-owned flagship Stillwater West platinum group element-nickel-copper-cobalt and gold project located in Stillwater District, Montana. The company also holds the Black Lake-Drayton Gold project in northwest Ontario, and the Kluane PGE-Ni-Cu-Co project located in Yukon Territory in Canada. In addition, it owns 100% interest in the Duke Island Copper-Nickel-PGE Project located in Alaska. The company was formerly known as Duncastle Gold Corp. and changed its name to Group Ten Metals Inc. in February 2015. Group Ten Metals Inc. was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.

name: P2 Gold Inc.
summary: P2 Gold Inc., a junior mining company, engages in the acquisition, exploration, and development of mineral properties in Canada and the United States. It primarily explores for gold, copper, silver, lead, and zinc deposits. The company holds an interest in the Silver Reef project that consists of 17 contiguous mineral tenures covering an area of approximately 23,182.7 hectares; the BAM property, which includes ten mineral tenures that covers an area of approximately 8,100 hectares; and the Todd Creek property consists of 69 mineral tenures covering an area of approximately 32,000 hectares located in northwest British Columbia, Canada. It also holds an interest in the Stockade property consists of 261 unpatented lode mining claims that covers an area of approximately 6,790 acres located in Malheur County; and the Lost Cabin property consists of 106 unpatented lode mining claims covering an area of approximately 2,190 acres, located in Lake County, Oregon. The company was formerly known as Central Timmins Exploration Corp. and changed its name to P2 Gold Inc. in August 2020. P2 Gold Inc. was incorporated in 2017 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.

name: Pure Gold Mining Inc.
summary: Pure Gold Mining Inc. engages in the acquisition, exploration, and development of gold, and other precious and base metal properties in Canada. Its principal property is the Pure Gold Red Lake Gold project comprises 251 mining leases, mining patents, and unpatented mining claims covering an area of approximately 4,700 hectares located near Red Lake, Ontario. The company is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.

name: Power Group Projects Corp.
summary: Power Group Projects Corp., an exploration stage company, engages in the acquisition, exploration, and development of resource properties in Canada. It primarily explores for cobalt and silver properties. The company holds interests in Smith-Cobalt Project consisting of 20 patented claims and 10 staked mineral claims covering an area of approximately 1,169.7 hectares located in Cobalt, Ontario. It also holds interest in The Ontario cobalt project consists of 14 mineral claims covering 2,944 hectares located in the Cobalt Camp, Ontario; and the Blueberry Lake property that consists of 46 claim units covering and area of approximately 800 hectares located in the Cassels Township of Ontario. The company was formerly known as Cobalt Power Group Inc. and changed its name to Power Group Projects Corp. in February 2019. Power Group Projects Corp. was incorporated in 2009 and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.

name: Prodigy Ventures Inc.
summary: Prodigy Ventures Inc. provides technology services to financial institutions and other large enterprises in Canada and the United States. It offers consulting services for strategy, design, project management, application development, cloud migration, and testing. The company also develops mobile enterprise and payments applications for banks and other enterprise customers; and offers digital transformation services, such as strategy, architecture, design, project management, agile development, quality engineering, and staff augmentation. In addition, it provides IDVerifact, a SaaS platform that enables the consumption of digital identity assets into critical business processes for enterprise clients. The company is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.

name: Prosper Gold Corp.
summary: Prosper Gold Corp. engages in the acquisition, exploration, and development of mineral properties in Canada. It explores for copper and gold resources. The company's property portfolio includes the Star property in British Columbia; and the Ontario projects in Ontario. It also holds an option to acquire a 100% interest in the Golden Sidewalk and Skinner gold properties, consisting of approximately 16,000 hectares of mineral claims and leases located in the Red Lake mining district of Ontario. The company was formerly known as Lander Energy Corporation and changed its name to Prosper Gold Corp. in April 2012. Prosper Gold Corp. was incorporated in 2007 and is based in Vancouver, Canada.

name: Pan Global Resources Inc.
summary: Pan Global Resources Inc., a junior resource company, engages in the base and precious metal exploration. It explores for lead, zinc, silver, gold, and copper. The company manages the Aguilas Project that includes 4 mineral exploration licenses covering 13,563 hectares, as well as additional mineral rights applications covering 2,803 hectares. It also has an option to acquire 100% of the Escacena Investigation Permit in Andalucia, Spain. The company was formerly known as Mosam Capital Corp. and changed its name to Pan Global Resources Inc. in December 2009. Pan Global Resources Inc. was founded in 2006 and is based in Vancouver, Canada.

name: Premier Health of America Inc.
summary: Premier Health of America Inc., a specialized healthcare services company, provides staffing and outsourced service solutions for healthcare needs in Canada. It also offers health consulting, nursing, and health-care services in remote communities, as well as medical transport services. The company offers its services through PSweb, a CRM platform. It serves governments, corporations, individuals, public and private hospitals, medical clinics, and retirement homes. The company is headquartered in Blainville, Canada.

name: Providence Gold Mines Inc.
summary: Providence Gold Mines Inc., an exploration stage company, engages in the exploration and evaluation of mineral properties located in the United States. The company primarily explores for gold ores. It holds interests in the Providence Mines Property located in the Summerville Mining District, Tuolumne County, California. The company was formerly known as Red Hut Metals Inc. and changed its name to Providence Gold Mines Inc. in July 2017. Providence Gold Mines Inc. was incorporated in 2010 and is based in Vancouver, Canada.

name: Philippine Metals Inc.
summary: Philippine Metals Inc., an exploration stage company, engages in the exploration and development of resource properties in Canada and the Philippines. It focuses on copper and gold deposits. The company holds an option agreement to acquire a 100% interest in the Consortium property that covers an area of 1,161 hectares located in British Columbia. Philippine Metals Inc. is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.

name: Phenom Resources Corp.
summary: Phenom Resources Corp., based in Vancouver, Canada, and founded in 2006, procures, prospects, assesses and advances mineral resources in Canada and the United States. It has the exclusive right to buy the whole of the Carlin gold-vanadium venture and the Section 22 site in Elko County, Nevada, and holds interests in the West Jerome copper deposit in Arizona. It was formerly First Vanadium Corp.

name: Pine Trail Real Estate Investment Trust USD (PINE.U)
summary: Pine Trail Real Estate Investment Trust USD (PINE.U) is a company listed on the TSX Venture Exchange under the ticker PINE-U and traded in USD.

name: Pine Trail Real Estate Investment Trust Units (PINE.UN)
summary: Pine Trail Real Estate Investment Trust is a Canadian REIT concentrating mostly on real estate related to healthcare, in particular medical office buildings in Ontario. It was founded in 2017 and has its head office in Toronto, Canada.

name: Pinehurst Capital II Inc.
summary: Pinehurst Capital II Inc. intends to identify and evaluate businesses and assets with a view to complete a qualifying transaction. The company was incorporated in 2018 and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.

name: Perimeter Medical Imaging AI, Inc.
summary: Perimeter Medical Imaging AI, Inc., a clinical stage medical device company, develops, patents, and commercializes advanced in-procedural medical imaging tools. The company offers an optical tissue imaging system, an imaging platform, which provides clinicians with the real time ability to assess tissue microstructures during diagnostic, surgical, and pathology procedures. The company was founded in 2013 and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.

name: Pinnacle Silver and Gold Corp.
summary: Pinnacle Silver and Gold Corp. is an exploration-stage company that acquires and develops mineral properties in the Americas, concentrating on silver and gold deposits. Formerly Newrange Gold Corp., it was established in 2006 and has its head office in Vancouver, Canada.

name: Pivotal Financial Corp.
summary: Pivotal Financial Corp. focuses on identifying and evaluating businesses and assets with a view to complete a qualifying transaction. The company was incorporated in 2020 and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.

name: PJX Resources Inc.
summary: PJX Resources Inc., a mineral exploration company, engages in the acquisition, exploration, and development of mineral resource properties in Canada. The company primarily explores for gold, silver, zinc, lead, and copper deposits. Its flagship mineral property is the Dewdney Trail property comprises 36 contiguous mineral tenures covering an area of approximately 13,043 hectares located in western Rocky Mountains of southeastern British Columbia. PJX Resources Inc. was incorporated in 2010 and is based in Toronto, Canada.

name: Simply Better Brands Corp.
summary: PureK Holdings Corp. manufactures and sells hemp based cannabidiol related products in the United States. The company offers tinctures, capsules, gummies, oils, edibles, topicals, sprays, vape pens, pet treats, and bath bombs, as well as tees, hoodies, beanies, caps, and other related products. It distributes its products through e-commerce website PureKana.com, as well as through retail stores, including larger retail chains and small independent retailers; wholesalers; and various brick and mortar retailers. The company was founded in 2017 and is headquartered in Paradise Valley, Arizona. PureK Holdings Corp. is a subsidiary of Heavenly Rx Ltd.

name: Parkit Enterprise Inc.
summary: Parkit Enterprise Inc. is a real estate investment firm specializing in acquisition and operation of income-producing parking facilities. The firm seeks to invest in the United States. Parkit Enterprise Inc. was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.

name: Plata Latina Minerals Corporation
summary: Plata Latina Minerals Corporation operates as a mineral exploration company. The company explores for silver and gold properties. Plata Latina Minerals Corporation was incorporated in 2010 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.

name: Progressive Planet Solutions Inc.
summary: Progressive Planet Solutions Inc., a junior mineral exploration company, engages in the acquisition and exploration of mineral properties in Canada. Its flagship property is the Z1 Zeolite mine located to the northeast of Cache Creek, British Columbia. The company was formerly known as Ashburton Ventures Inc. and changed its name to Progressive Planet Solutions Inc. in June 2018. Progressive Planet Solutions Inc. was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.

name: Paloma Resources Inc.
summary: Paloma Resources Inc., through its wholly owned subsidiary, Paloma Ventures (Nevada) Inc., engages in the exploration and development of oil and gas properties. It owns 1-3% interest in five oil and gas leases located in the Jefferson and Wilkinson counties, Mississippi. The company was formerly known as Paloma Ventures Inc. and changed its name to Paloma Resources Inc. in February 2004. Paloma Resources Inc. was incorporated in 1985 and is based in Vancouver, Canada.

name: Pulsar Helium Inc.
summary: Pulsar Helium Inc. acquires, explores and develops helium deposits in the United States and Greenland. The Topaz Project in Lake County, Minnesota, anchors its portfolio. Established in 2022 as Pulsar Holdings Inc., it is headquartered in White Rock, Canada.

name: Plateau Energy Metals Inc.
summary: Plateau Energy Metals Inc., a junior resource company, engages in the acquisition, exploration, and evaluation of mineral properties in Peru. The company explores for lithium and uranium deposits. It holds interests in Falchani Lithium Project and Macusani Uranium Project in the Puno District of southeastern Peru. The company also holds a total of 151 mining concessions covering approximately 93,000 hectares on the Macusani Plateau in Peru. The company was formerly known as Plateau Uranium Inc. and changed its name to Plateau Energy Metals Inc. in March 2018. The company was founded in 2006 and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.

name: Plurilock Security Inc.
summary: Plurilock Security Solutions Inc., an identity-centric cybersecurity company, provides multi-factor authentication solutions using behavioral-biometric, environmental, and contextual technologies. The company offers Plurilock ADAPT, an augmented behavioral biometrics, which provides out-of-band multi-factor authentication by analyzing identity signals; and Plurilock DEFEND, a patented behavioral biometrics that recognizes users by the way they work. It serves financial services, healthcare, critical infrastructure, and government and military industries. The company is headquartered in Victoria, Canada.

name: Planet X II Capital Corp.
summary: Planet X II Capital Corp. is a company listed on the TSX Venture Exchange under the ticker PLXX-P and traded in CAD.

name: Playfair Mining Ltd.
summary: Playfair Mining Ltd., an exploration stage company, engages in the acquisition, exploration, and development of mineral properties. The company explores for gold, copper, cobalt, and nickel. It holds a 100% interest in the Grey River Tungsten property consisting of nine mineral claims covering an area of 1,750 hectares located in southern Newfoundland, Canada; and holds a 100% interest in the Granite Lake Molybdenum located in central Newfoundland, Canada. The company also holds 100% interest in the RKV Cu-Co-Ni Project that covers an area of 344 square kilometers located in in south-central Norway. Playfair Mining Ltd. was incorporated in 1988 and is based in Vancouver, Canada.

name: Perseverance Metals Inc.
summary: Perseverance Metals, Inc. is a mineral exploration company that identifies, acquires and explores nickel-copper-cobalt-PGE and lithium projects. It was founded in 2022 and has its head office in Vancouver, Canada.

name: Panoro Minerals Ltd.
summary: Panoro Minerals Ltd., an exploration-stage company, engages in the acquisition, exploration, and development of mineral properties in Peru. The company explores for copper, molybdenum, gold, silver, and zinc deposits. Its flagship project is the Cotabambas project located in the District of Cotabambas. The company was formerly known as Panoro Resources Ltd. and changed its name to Panoro Minerals Ltd. in June 2003. Panoro Minerals Ltd. was incorporated in 1994 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.

name: Prime Meridian Resources Corp.
summary: Prime Meridian Resources Corp. engages in the exploration and evaluation of resource properties. The company explores for nickel, copper, and palladium deposits. It focuses on the exploration and development of the Kelly Palladium project consisting of 17 claims covering an area of 375 hectares located in Sudbury, Ontario. The company also has 100% interest in three claims in the Pakwash Lake projects; and an option to acquire two sets of mineral claims in the Bruce Lake area and the Camping Lake area located in the Red Lake District of Ontario. Prime Meridian Resources Corp. is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.

name: ProAm Explorations Corporation
summary: ProAm Explorations Corporation operates as a junior mineral, and oil and natural gas exploration and development company in Canada and the United States. The company owns working interests in various oil and gas properties located in Muskingum County, Eastern Ohio; Indiana County, Pennsylvania; Logan County, Arkansas; Oklahoma City, Oklahoma; Tucker County, West Virginia, and Okotoks, Alberta. It also holds a 100% interest in the Samuel Lake property; and an option to acquire a 100% interest in the Jet property located in Elko County, Nevada. The company is headquartered in North Vancouver, Canada.

name: Kraken Robotics Inc.
summary: Kraken Robotics Inc., a marine technology company, designs, manufactures, and sells software-centric sensors, batteries, and underwater robotic systems for unmanned underwater vehicles used in military and commercial applications. The company offers AquaPix interferometric synthetic aperture sonar (InSAS) for use in onboard autonomous underwater vehicles, remotely operated tow vehicles, remotely operated vehicles, and tow bodies; AquaPix miniature InSAS, an off the shelf configurable InSAS; and SeaVision, a subsea 3D laser imaging system. It also provides KATFISH, an intelligent towed SAS system; ThunderFish, a hovering autonomous underwater vehicle; ALARS, an autonomous launch and recovery system that enablea an unmanned vehicle and its payloads to be brought aboard to a host ship; and DataPod, a removable data storage module for marine applications. In addition, the company offers pressure tolerant encapsulated components, such as batteries, thrusters, actuators, and electronics; and robotics as a service, as well as implements digital signal processing and user interface software for anti-submarine warfare sonar applications. It has operations in Canada, the United States, France, Italy, Israel, the United Kingdom, Germany, and internationally. The company was formerly known as Kraken Sonar Inc. and changed its name to Kraken Robotics Inc. in September 2017. Kraken Robotics Inc. was incorporated in 2008 and is headquartered in Mt. Pearl, Canada.

name: Power Metallic Mines Inc.
summary: Power Metallic Mines Inc. is a Canadian junior company that acquires and explores mineral properties, looking for silver, gold, platinum group elements, cobalt, copper and nickel. It was established in 1987 by Verna Wilson and has its base in Toronto, Canada.

name: Pantera Silver Corp.
summary: Pantera Silver Corp. operates as a junior mineral exploration company. It holds interest in the Nuevo Taxco Silver Gold Project that covers an area of approximately 1,100 hectares located in the Pregones Mining District, Mexico. The company was formerly known as Red Oak Mining Corp. and changed its name to Pantera Silver Corp. in March 2021. Pantera Silver Corp. is based in Vancouver, Canada.

name: POCML 6 Inc.
summary: POCML 6 Inc. intends to identify and evaluate businesses and assets with a view to complete the qualifying transaction. The company was incorporated in 2020 and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.

summary: Pan Orient Energy Corp., a junior oil and natural gas company, engages in the exploration, development, and production of oil and gas properties in Thailand, Indonesia, and Canada. It holds a 100% interest in the L53/48 concession located in west of Bangkok, Thailand; a 49% interest in the East Jabung production sharing contract located in South Sumatra, Indonesia; and a 50% interest in the Sawn Lake property comprising 88 contiguous sections of heavy oil sands leases situated in the central Alberta Peace River Oil Sands area. The company is based in Calgary, Canada.

name: Perisson Petroleum Corporation
summary: Perisson Petroleum Corporation engages in the exploration and production of oil and gas properties in Canada and the Republic of Colombia. The company owns a 100% interest in the VMM-17 oil block license covering an area of approximately 39,927 hectares located in the Magdalena Basin in central Colombia. Perisson Petroleum Corporation is based in Calgary, Canada.

name: Pond Technologies Holdings Inc.
summary: Pond Technologies Holdings Inc., a technology company, produces microalgal biomass using available sources of carbon dioxide(CO2), including CO2 rich emission sources from industrial plants and the licensing of its technology. The resultant algae is used in the supply of nutraceuticals, superfoods, and aquaculture and animal feeds, as well as feedstock in the production of biofoams and algae based biomaterials, and other algae derived product markets. It also focuses on the terrestrial plant and cannabis industry. The company is headquartered in Markham, Canada.

name: Pool Safe Inc.
summary: Pool Safe Inc. manufactures and sells pool safe products in the United States. The company offers PoolSafe, a product that functions as a multi-purpose safe, beverage cooler and holder, and server call-button, as well as a solar-powered charger for USB compatible devices, including phones, cameras, and tablets. It serves owners and operators of hotels, resorts, waterparks, and cruise ships. The company was founded in 2011 and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.

name: PopReach Corporation
summary: PopReach Corporation operates as a free-to-play mobile game publisher in North America, Europe, Australia, and internationally. It focuses on acquiring and optimizing proven game franchises. The company owns 12 game franchises, including Smurfs' Village, Kitchen Scramble, Gardens of Time, City Girl Life, War of Nations, and Kingdoms of Camelot. The company is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.

name: Portofino Resources Inc.
summary: Portofino Resources Inc. acquires, explores for, and develops mineral properties in the Americas. The company holds an option to acquire 100% interests in the Sapawe West property that comprises 3 claims totaling 1,147 hectares located in the Schwenger and McCaul Townships, Ontario; the Gold Creek property comprising 5 mining claims containing 197 contiguous cell units covering an area of approximately 4,036 hectares located primarily in the Duckworth Township, Ontario; and the Melema West gold property covering an area of 869 hectares located to the northeast of the town of Atikokan, Ontario. Its properties also include the South of Otter project covering an area of 5,363 hectares located to the southeast of the town of Red Lake, Ontario; and the lithium salar properties in Catamarca, Argentina. In addition, the company has option assignment agreement to acquire a 100% interest in the Bruce lake Property covering an area of 1,428 hectares located in the Red lake, Ontario; and interest in the Allison Lake North lithium and rare elements property that comprises 4 claims covering an area of 1,618 hectares located in northwestern Ontario. The company was formerly known as Crude Investments Corp. and changed its name to Portofino Resources Inc. in March 2012. Portofino Resources Inc. was founded in 2011 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.

name: Pacific Silk Road Resources Group Inc.
summary: Pacific Silk Road Resources Group Inc., an exploration stage mining company, engages in the acquisition, exploration, and development of mineral properties in Canada. It explores for potash deposits. The company was formerly known as Pacific Potash Corporation and changed its name to Pacific Silk Road Resources Group Inc. in June 2018. Pacific Silk Road Resources Group Inc. was founded in 2006 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.

name: Pacific Paradym Energy Inc.
summary: Pacific Paradym Energy Inc. engages in the acquisition, exploration, and development of oil and gas properties in North America. It has a 25% participating interest in the Taber Property located in Alberta. The company was incorporated in 1981 and is based in Vancouver, Canada.

name: Prospect Park Capital Corp.
summary: Prospect Park Capital Corp., an investment company, focuses on public healthcare sector in Canada. The company was incorporated in 2012 and is based in Toronto, Canada.

summary: Pacific Imperial Mines Inc. engages in the identification, evaluation, acquisition, exploration, and development of mineral properties. It also has an option to acquire 100% in the TREK 31 Property, consisting of five claims that covers an area of 94 km2 located in the Nechako Plateau of central British Columbia. The company was incorporated in 1987 and is based in Vancouver, Canada.

summary: Prospector Metals Corp., a Vancouver-based company incorporated in 2007, identifies, explores and develops mineral properties in Canada and the United States, aiming to find gold, silver and copper deposits. Its assets include a full interest in the Gaffney gold property in central British Columbia and the Pine Pass Project in the province's northeast.

name: PPX Mining Corp.
summary: PPX Mining Corp. explores and develops, mining a gold and silver project, with a focus on the Igor Project in northern Peru. It was founded in 1987 and has its head office in Toronto, Canada.

name: Petroteq Energy Inc.
summary: Petroteq Energy Inc., through its subsidiaries, engages in the oil sands mining and oil extraction operations in the United States. The company mines and extracts oil from tar sands. It holds rights to mine, extract, and produce oil and associated hydrocarbons and minerals from oil sands containing heavy oil and bitumen under mineral leases covering approximately 2,541.76 acres in the Asphalt Ridge area of Utah, including 1,229.82 acres held under the TMC Mineral Lease and an additional 833.03 and 478.91 acres, respectively, held under the State of Utah's School and Institutional Trust Land Administration Leases. The company also operates rights under five leases covering lands consisting of approximately 5,960 acres situated in Uintah, Wayne, and Garfield Counties, Utah. In addition, it is developing a blockchain-powered supply chain management platform for the oil and gas industry. The company was formerly known as MCW Energy Group Limited and changed its name to Petroteq Energy Inc. in May 2017. Petroteq Energy Inc. is based in Sherman Oaks, California.

name: Probe Metals Inc.
summary: Probe Metals Inc., a junior resource company, engages in the acquisition, exploration, and development of mineral properties in Canada. The company's principal project is the Val-d'Or East project comprising 1,000 claims covering an area of 43,638 hectares located in the city of Val-d'Or, Quebec. It also holds interest in the Detour Quebec project, which includes approximately 1,434 claims located in north of Rouyn-Noranda, Quebec; and Casa-Cameron project comprising 308 claims covering an area of approximately 169 square kilometers. The company was formerly known as 2450260 Ontario Inc. and changed its name to Probe Metals Inc. in February 2015. Probe Metals Inc. was incorporated in 2015 and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.

name: Paleo Resources, Inc.
summary: Paleo Resources, Inc., an oil and gas, and mineral exploration company, engages in the acquisition, exploration, and development of the oil and gas and precious and base metal properties in Canada and the United States. It holds a 50% interest in the Joffre D-3 B Oil Pool located in Alberta; and a 100% interest in the Burchell Lake property covering an area of 5,900 hectares located in the Shebandowan gold camp in Ontario. The company's Burchell Lake Property is prospective for gold, copper, and molybdenum minerals. It also develops and produces oil and gas assets in Polk and Tyler counties, Texas. The company was formerly known as Tanager Energy Inc. and changed its name to Paleo Resources, Inc. in April 2019. Paleo Resources, Inc. was founded in 1945 and is headquartered in San Antonio, Texas.

name: Precipitate Gold Corp.
summary: Precipitate Gold Corp. engages in the exploration, exploitation, and development of mineral resources in Canada and the Dominican Republic. The company primarily explores for gold and base metal deposits. Its properties in the Dominican Republic include the Pueblo Grande, Juan de Herrera, and Ponton properties that cover an area of approximately 25,922 hectares. The company was incorporated in 2011 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.

name: Pearl River Holdings Limited
summary: Pearl River Holdings Limited, through its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacture and distribution of plastic products in the People's Republic of China, Australia, and the United States. The company was incorporated in 1994 and is based in London, Canada.

name: Pershimex Resources Corporation
summary: Pershimex Resources Corporation engages in the exploration and evaluation of mineral resources in Canada. It primarily explores for gold deposits. The company holds interests in the Malartic property, which consists of 6 blocks of contiguous claims; the Forsan property comprising 27 claims covering an area of approximately 8 square kilometers; and the Belleterre project, which includes the Blondeau-Guillet and Chevrier properties located in Quebec. It also holds interests in the Villebon property consisting of 43 claims covering an area of 1,780 hectares located in the Villebon Township, Abitibi; and the Courville property that consists of 361 claims covering an area of approximately 151.82 square kilometers located in the Carpentier and Courville townships. The company was formerly known as Khalkos Exploration Inc. Pershimex Resources Corporation is based in Rouyn-Noranda, Canada.

name: Prism Resources Inc.
summary: Prism Resources Inc., a natural resources company, engages in the acquisition and exploration of mineral properties. The company owns a 7.5% net profit interest in the Aurora and Sunday Lake claims in the Porcupine Mining District of Ontario, Canada. Prism Resources Inc. is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.

name: Personas Social Incorporated
summary: Personas Social Incorporated provides live streaming social media products and services for consumers and businesses on its live streaming social media platform. The company focuses on providing social commerce enabled products that allow for a monetizable user experience to all users. It operates in Canada, the United States, Africa, the Middle East, India, Europe, and internationally. The company was formerly known as Peeks Social Ltd. and changed its name to Personas Social Incorporated in July 2020. Personas Social Incorporated is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.

name: Prairie Storm Resources Corp.
summary: Prairie Storm Energy Corp. focuses on the acquisition, exploration, and development of oil and gas assets in the Willesden Green area of West Central Alberta, Canada. It holds working interest in 49,785 net acres of petroleum and natural gas rights. The company is headquartered in Calgary, Canada.

name: PetroShale Inc.
summary: PetroShale Inc., an independent oil company, engages in the acquisition, development, and production of oil-weighted assets primarily in the Bakken and Three Forks formations in the Williston Basin area of North Dakota. The company holds approximately 8,218 net acres of land in Middle Bakken, Three Forks Benches, Pronghorn/Sanish, and Lodgepole. As of December 31, 2020, the company had approximately 84.7 million barrels of oil equivalent of total proved plus probable reserves. PetroShale Inc. was founded in 1994 and is headquartered in Calgary, Canada.

name: Prospectiva Resources Ltd.
summary: Prospectiva Resources Ltd. evaluates, acquires and explores mineral properties holding base and precious metals, focusing on prospective areas in Brazil. It was founded in 2021 and has its head office in Toronto, Canada.

name: PsyBio Therapeutics Corp.

It also engages in the research and development of naturally occurring tryptamines found in varieties of mushrooms, other tryptamines, and phenethylamines; and new molecular structures that do not occur in nature, as well as have therapeutics properties. PsyBio Therapeutics Corp. is headquartered in Coconut Creek, Florida.

name: Petrox Resources Corp.
summary: Petrox Resources Corp., a junior oil and gas company, engages in the acquisition, exploration, development, and production of petroleum and natural gas resources in Canada. It owns a production property located in Fletwode, Saskatchewan. The company was formerly known as Petrox Capital Corporation and changed its name to Petrox Resources Corp. in August 2012. Petrox Resources Corp. was incorporated in 2011 and is based in Calgary, Canada.

name: Pioneering Technology Corp.
summary: Pioneering Technology Corp. engages in developing, manufacturing, and sale of thermo-based technology solutions in Canada and the United States. It offers SmartBurner, a plug-and-play solution for electric coil stoves; SmartRange, a fire protection for electric glass-top stove; and Smart Micro, a microwave safety solution to prevent microwave fires and nuisance/ false smoke alarm activations. The company also provides SmartBurner Polish to restore, protect, and maintain SmartBurner's original appearance. Pioneering Technology Corp. is based in Mississauga, Canada.

name: Principal Technologies Inc.
summary: Principal Technologies, Inc. operates in healthcare technology, including project management of international clinical studies mainly for medical device technologies. It is also assembling a varied set of investments in healthcare technology businesses that could be distributed globally and intellectual property that can improve treatment quality, cost efficiency and the patient pathway.

name: Pender Growth Fund Inc.
summary: Pender Growth Fund Inc. specializes in later stage, special situations, and restructuring investments. The fund also provides expansion capital and invests in small caps and Eligible Small Businesses ("ESBs"). It seeks to invest in illiquid public and private companies in information technology, communications, life sciences, and proprietary technologies sectors and undervalued technology companies. The fund targets companies based in British Columbia, Canada. It typically invests over Cdn $500,000 ($0.51) or invests between Cdn $1.5 million ($1.53 million) and Cdn $3 million ($3.06 million) in each portfolio company with revenues between Cdn $5 million ($5.10 million) and Cdn $15 million ($15.30 million). The fund prefers to invest in undervalued public companies.

name: Plantify Foods, Inc.
summary: Plantify Foods, Inc. is a company listed on the TSX Venture Exchange under the ticker PTFY and traded in CAD.

name: POET Technologies Inc.

name: Current Water Technologies Inc.

The company provides patented and proprietary technologies for the treatment of waste water and drinking water that are contaminated by metals or nutrients, such as arsenic and nitrate/ammonia associated with the mining, metal processing, chemical, agricultural, municipal, and waste management sectors; and for the recovery of nickel and other valuable metals from waste mill sulphide tailings associated with the mining sector. Its technologies comprise electro-static deionization, a electrochemical process that lowers the concentration of total dissolved solids in water; ammonia removal technology, a technology used for the removal of dissolved ammonia from industrial and municipal water, including wastewater, storm water, sewage effluent, and mine waste water; NitrEL system, an electrochemical water treatment process that reduces nitrate concentrations in contaminated drinking water, groundwater, and industrial process wastewater streams; AmdEl an electrochemical system that prevents the oxidation of sulphide minerals in tailings or waste rock; and ExtrEL for the recovery of metals from sulphide tailings and ore. The company was formerly known as ENPAR Technologies Inc. and changed its name to Current Water Technologies Inc. in January 2018. Current Water Technologies Inc. was incorporated in 1996 and is headquartered in Guelph, Canada.

Its products under development include injectable generic chemotherapy drugs, such as WAV-101 for the treatment of non-small cell lung cancer and pleural mesothelioma; and WAV-102 to treat multiple myeloma and mantle cell lymphoma. The company has a collaboration with the University of Manitoba for the development of a synthetic library of chloroquine analogs to treat COVID-19. summary: XXIX Metal Corp. is a Canadian company that prospects for, develops and extracts mineral resources, targeting copper and gold. Established in 2018 and headquartered in Toronto, it was formerly named QC Copper and Gold Inc. until it changed its name in 2024.

name: First Light Capital Corp
summary: First Light Capital Corp. does not have significant operations. It intends to identify and evaluate businesses or assets with a view to completing a qualifying transaction. The company was incorporated in 2018 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.

name: Mongolia Growth Group Ltd.
summary: Mongolia Growth Group Ltd. primarily operates in the subscription services industry, offering clients access to its weekly data publications. Additionally, the company is involved in managing a portfolio of securities investments. Established in 2007, the firm was formerly known as Summus Capital Corp. until it adopted the name Mongolia Growth Group Ltd. in February 2011. Its corporate headquarters are situated in Toronto, Canada.

name: Mongolia Growth Group Ltd.
summary: Mongolia Growth Group Ltd., a real estate investment and development company, owns commercial investment property assets in Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia. Its investment portfolio consists of residential, office, retail, and land and redevelopment sites. The company was formerly known as Summus Capital Corp. and changed its name to Mongolia Growth Group Ltd. in February 2011. Mongolia Growth Group Ltd. was incorporated in 2007 and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.

name: Pirate Gold Corp.
summary: Pirate Gold Corp., headquartered in Toronto, Canada, is an exploration-stage company formerly named Sokoman Minerals Corp. It acquires and develops mineral assets in Canada, with emphasis on gold in Newfoundland and Labrador, where its principal asset is the wholly owned Moosehead gold property.

name: THS Maple Holdings Ltd.
summary: THS Maple Holdings Ltd. is a company listed on the TSX Venture Exchange under the ticker YAY and traded in CAD.

name: YDx Innovation Corp.
summary: YDx Innovation Corp., a technology company that develops augmented and virtual reality, esports events, and interactive exhibitions technologies in Canada and Brazil. Its Arkave VR Arena division operates a gaming platform for virtual reality experience to location based venues. The company's YDreams Global division develops interactive experiences for conceptual spaces and exhibitions. Its offers Game On Festival, a format of esports events that combines digital storytelling and competitive gaming. The company was formerly known as YDreams Global Interactive Technologies Inc. and changed its name to YDx Innovation Corp. in January 2019. YDx Innovation Corp. was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.

name: Yorkton Equity Group Inc.
summary: Yorkton Equity Group Inc. operates as a real estate development company with an investment property located in Edmonton, Alberta. The company is based in Edmonton, Canada.

name: CHAR Technologies Ltd.
summary: CHAR Technologies Ltd., a cleantech development and services company, engages in biocarbon development activity. It offers SulfaCHAR, a gas-cleaning solution that removes hydrogen sulfide from renewable natural gas; Cleanfyre, a carbon neutral coal replacement; and equipment for industrial air and water treatment. The company also provides environmental consulting services comprising environmental management, site investigation and remediation, engineering, and resource services. It serves food and beverage, industrial, and renewable gas project customers. CHAR Technologies Ltd. was founded in 2011 and is headquartered in North York, Canada.

name: Edgewater Wireless Systems Inc.
summary: Edgewater Wireless Systems Inc. develops and commercializes technologies and intellectual property for the wireless communications market in North America, Asia, the Middle East and Africa, and Europe. It offers Wi-Fi spectrum slicing solutions, and dual channel and broadcast Wi-Fi products; access point routers and channel association solutions; PowerZoning, a channel power control product for multi-channel single radio Wi-Fi networks; spectral surveillance architecture; and multi-channel single radio (MCSR) chipsets, radio cards, and silicon solutions, as well as intellectual patent licensing. The company was formerly known as KIK Polymers Inc. and changed its name to Edgewater Wireless Systems Inc. in January 2012. Edgewater Wireless Systems Inc. was incorporated in 1980 and is headquartered in Ottawa, Canada.

name: Gold Terra Resource Corp.
summary: Gold Terra Resource Corp. engages in the exploration and development of mineral properties in Canada. The company holds 100% interest in the Yellowknife City gold project that includes Northbelt, Southbelt, and Eastbelt properties in the Northwest Territories, as well as other claims and property interests encompassing 783 square kilometers of land on the Yellowknife greenstone belt. It also has 100% interest in the Stewart copper/gold property, which consists of 2 mineral exploration licenses totaling approximately 137 claims covering approximately 34.25 square kilometers located in the Burin Peninsula of Newfoundland. In addition, the company holds interest in the Aurora 1 and 2 claims. The company was formerly known as TerraX Minerals Inc. and changed its name to Gold Terra Resource Corp. in February 2020. Gold Terra Resource Corp. was incorporated in 2007 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.

name: Ynvisible Interactive Inc. Class A
summary: Ynvisible Interactive Inc. develops and sells electrochromic displays in Europe. The company also provides system design, integration, and production services, which include applications and assessment, design and proof-of-concept, system integration and prototyping, production design and implementation, and commercial production. It serves the healthcare and wellness, consumer products, logistics and supply chain, and other printing industries. Ynvisible Interactive Inc. is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.

name: YANGAROO Inc.
summary: YANGAROO Inc., a software company, provides work-flow management solutions for the media industry in Canada and the United States. The company offers Digital Media Distribution System (DMDS) platform, an end-to-end technology solution that provides an integrated workflow based digital distribution and data management solutions. Its DMDS platform also provides audio and video content for music, music videos, and advertising to television, radio, media, retailers, award shows, and other authorized recipients. The company was formerly known as Musicrypt.com Inc. and changed its name to YANGAROO Inc. in July 2007. YANGAROO Inc. was incorporated in 1999 and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.

name: Space Kingdom Digital Capital Corp.
summary: Space Kingdom Digital Capital Corp. is a company listed on the TSX Venture Exchange under the ticker YSK-P and traded in CAD.

name: Wi2Wi Corporation
summary: Wi2Wi Corporation designs, integrates, and manufactures wireless technology solutions in the United States and internationally. It offers wireless connectivity solutions, such as multi-protocol, Wi-Fi, and MCU embedded Bluetooth modules; location and navigation products, including GNSS and GPS modules; and timing and frequency control products comprising clock oscillators, crystals, crystal filters, and RF and microwave filters. The company also provides rubber duck antennas, PCB antennas, and antenna connector cables. Its products are primarily used in Internet of Things (IoT), industrial IoT, avionics, space, military, defense, infrastructure, automotive, industrial, communications, mobile-radio, personal navigation devices, consumer, and medical applications. The company sells its products to OEMs, enterprises, and distributors. Wi2Wi Corporation was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in San Jose, California.

name: Zacatecas Silver Corp.
summary: Zacatecas Silver Corp. engages in the acquisition and exploration of silver deposits in the Fresnillo Silver Belt in Mexico. It owns a 100% interest in the Zacatecas property covering 19,338 acres located in the Zacatecas State, Mexico. The company incorporated in 2020 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.

name: Zodiac Gold Inc.
summary: Zodiac Gold Inc. is a Vancouver-based gold exploration company with a portfolio of properties in Liberia, West Africa, including the Todi project. David Kol and Mark Kol founded it on May 26, 2020.

name: Zeb Nickel Corp.
summary: ZEB Nickel Corp. acquires, explores and develops mineral properties and holds rights in a project in South Africa's Limpopo province. Founded in 2019, it has its headquarters in Vancouver, Canada.

name: Zimtu Capital Corp.
summary: Zimtu Capital Corp. is a private equity and venture capital firm specializing in seed stage, early stage, acquisition, pre-IPO investments in private micro and small-cap resource companies. The firm invests in potash mineral properties. It prefers to invest in Western Canada. It also focuses on the exploration and development of tantalum and niobium deposits in Central British Columbia; and involves in the exploration and evaluation of gold deposits in South-Central Northwest territories. The projects are normally acquired on a 50-50% basis with geological and prospecting partners with proceeds from sales split the same. Zimtu Capital Corp. was founded on July 4, 2006 and is based in Vancouver, Canada with an additional office in Toronto, Canada.

name: Zena Mining Corp.
summary: Zena Mining Corp., an exploration stage company, explores for and develops industrial mineral properties in Canada. The company primarily explores for barite. It holds 100% interest in various industrial mineral rights located in the Greenwood mining division of British Columbia. The company was formerly known as Zena Capital Corp. and changed its name to Zena Mining Corp. in June 2009. Zena Mining Corp. was incorporated in 2000 and is based in North Vancouver, Canada.

name: Zero Candida Technologies Inc.
summary: Zero Candida Technologies Inc. is a company listed on the TSX Venture Exchange under the ticker ZCT and traded in CAD.

name: Zedcor Inc.
summary: Zedcor Inc. provides rental of surface equipment and accommodations, and security and surveillance services in Canada. Its Rentals segment engages in the rental of surface equipment, temporary accommodation, and power generation equipment to customers in oil and gas exploration, construction, and emergency response markets. Security & Surveillance segment offers remote surveillance, live monitoring, and security personnel through a fleet of hybrid solar light towers equipped with high resolution security cameras and equipment to customers in pipeline construction, civil and municipal construction, oil and gas exploration, and emergency response markets. As of December 31, 2020, its fleet includes 200 temporary accommodation units; 40 diesel and natural gas generators; 98 light towers, including 16 stadium light towers; and 404 pieces of rig matting, as well as fluid storage tanks. The company was formerly known as Zedcor Energy Inc. and changed its name to Zedcor Inc. in September 2020. Zedcor Inc. was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Leduc, Canada.

name: Zentek Ltd.
summary: ZEN Graphene Solutions Ltd., a graphene technology solutions company, engages in developing graphene-based nanomaterial products and applications. It owns 100% interest in the Albany Graphite Project located in Northern Ontario, Canada. ZEN Graphene Solutions has collaboration with Graphene Composites Ltd. to develop a COVID-19 virucidal graphene-based composite ink for face masks; and has a research collaboration agreement with the Deutsches Zentrum für Luft- und Raumfahrt (‘DLR', the German Aerospace Center) to investigate the use of Albany Pure graphene-based nanomaterials in the fabrication of novel carbon aerogel composites. The company was formerly known as Zenyatta Ventures Ltd. and changed its name to ZEN Graphene Solutions Ltd. in January 2019. ZEN Graphene Solutions Ltd. was incorporated in 2008 and is based in Thunder Bay, Canada.

name: Zenith Capital Corp.
summary: Zenith Capital Corp., a biotechnology investment company, develops bromodomain inhibitors for the treatment of cancer and other disorders with unmet medical needs. Its lead compound ZEN-3694 which is in phase II clinical trials for the treatment of metastatic castration resistant prostate cancer and in a phase 1b/2 clinical trial for triple negative breast cancer. The company was incorporated in 2013 and is based in Calgary, Canada.

name: Zephyr Minerals Ltd.
summary: Zephyr Minerals Ltd., through its subsidiary, Zephyr Gold USA Ltd., engages in the exploration, evaluation, and development of mineral properties in Canada and the United States. It explores for gold, silver, zinc, and lead deposits. The company holds a 100% interest in the Dawson-Green Mountain project comprising 140 unpatented mining claims, 11 patented lode mining claims, 2 patented placer mining claims, and 1 state lease covering an area of 1,446 hectares located in Colorado, the United States; a key mineral claim, the Judith Placer Mining Claim at its Dawson gold project in Colorado. Zephyr Minerals Ltd. was incorporated in 2010 and is headquartered in Halifax, Canada.

name: Stardust Metal Corp.
summary: Stardust Metal Corp. acquires and explores mineral properties, among them Goldie, Kirkland West, Omega Mine and McGarry. It was founded in 1988 with headquarters in Toronto, Canada.

name: China Keli Electric Company Ltd.
summary: China Keli Electric Company Ltd. does not have significant operations. Previously, it was engaged in the manufacture and installation of electrical components and equipment in the People's Republic of China. The company is based in Vancouver, Canada.

name: BULGOLD Inc.
summary: BULGOLD Inc. is a company listed on the TSX Venture Exchange under the ticker ZLTO and traded in CAD.

name: ZoomAway Technologies Inc.
summary: ZoomAway Technologies Inc., a technology company that focuses on the hospitality and travel industries. The company's flagship product is ZoomedOUT, a complete modernization and re-imagination of mobile travel apps. It offers travel and non-travel advertisers access to a potential source of incremental traffic and transactions through its various media and advertising offerings on its transaction-based websites. The company was formerly known as ZoomAway Travel Inc. and changed its name to ZoomAway Technologies Inc. in April 2021. ZoomAway Technologies Inc. was incorporated in 1987 and is headquartered in Reno, Nevada.

name: Group Eleven Resources Corp.
summary: Group Eleven Resources Corp. explores for and evaluates mineral properties in Ireland. It primarily explores for copper, zinc, lead, and silver deposits. The company owns 100% interests in the Silvermines project comprising 18 prospecting licenses (PLs) covering 598 square kilometers located in the northern County Tipperary; the PG West project consisting of 25 PLs totalling 707 square kilometers located in the Limerick region; and the Tralee project comprising 2 PLs that covers approximately 70 square kilometers situated in Ireland. It also holds a 60% interest in the Ballinalack project that comprises 6 PLs covering an area of 211 square kilometers located in north-east Ireland; and 76.56% interest in the Stonepark project consisting of 6 PLs covering an area of 183.5 square kilometers located in County Limerick, Ireland. Group Eleven Resources Corp. was founded in 2015 and is based in Vancouver, Canada.

name: ZincX Resources Corp.
summary: ZincX Resources Corp. engages in the exploration and evaluation of mineral resource properties in Canada. The company explores for zinc, lead, and silver deposits. It holds a 100% interest in the Akie property that consists of 46 mineral claims covering an area of approximately 116 square kilometers; and the Kechika Regional project comprising 184 mineral claims covering an area of approximately 682 square kilometers located in northeastern British Columbia. The company was formerly known as Canada Zinc Metals Corp. and changed its name to ZincX Resources Corp. in May 2018. ZincX Resources Corp. was incorporated in 1988 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.

name: Zoomd Technologies Ltd.
summary: Zoomd Technologies Ltd. develops proprietary patented technology for leveraging onsite search for publishers, media agencies, and advertisers. It offers an internal site search engine for clients to implement search in publishers' web site. The company also provides unified mobile user acquisition platform for managing all user acquisition activity under one unified command and control screen for advertisers. Zoomd Technologies Ltd. was founded in 2012 and is based in Vancouver, Canada.

name: Zonte Metals Inc.
summary: Zonte Metals Inc., a junior exploration company, focuses on acquiring and exploring gold and copper deposits in Canada. The company holds a 100% interest in the Wings Point project that consists of four mineral exploration licenses covering 144 contiguous claims covering an area of 36 sq km located in the Province of Newfoundland and Labrador. It also holds an option agreement to acquire a 100% interest in the McConnells Jest project, which consists of 172 contiguous quartz claims covering an area of approximately 3,371 hectares located in the Yukon Territory; and the Cross Hills project that comprises 509 claims covering an area of 12,725 hectares located in the island portion of Newfoundland and Labrador. The company was formerly known as Empire Capital Corp. and changed its name to Zonte Metals Inc. in July 2011. Zonte Metals Inc. was founded in 2009 and is headquartered in Halifax, Canada.

name: Zonetail Inc.
summary: Zonetail Inc. provides a mobile platform that transforms the way residents of high- and mid-rise apartments and condominium buildings to manage their homes by connecting people to products, amenities, and services. The company's platform addresses the needs of residents of multi-family residential buildings, planned communities, condominium communities, and housing cooperatives. Zonetail Inc. is based in Toronto, Canada.

name: ZoomerMedia Limited
summary: ZoomerMedia Limited operates as a multimedia company in Canada. The company operates through five segments: Television, Radio, Print, Royalty, and Other. It is involved in the business of television, radio, magazine, Internet, conferences, and trade shows primarily for the 45 plus age group. The company's television properties include Vision TV, a multi-cultural and multi-faith specialty television service; ONE: Get Fit, which offers 24 hours of fitness and healthy living programs; JoyTV that provides a mix of Christian, multi-cultural, local programming, news, views, and music; Faith TV, a channel for broadcasting Christian and local programming; and TVL Channel 5, a linear television channel guide available to households. It also operates various radio stations, such as CFMZ-FM Toronto and CFMX-FM Cobourg; CFMO-FM Collingwood; CFZM-AM 740 Toronto and CFZM-FM 96.7FM Toronto – Zoomer Radio; and Toronto's Timeless Hits. In addition, the company publishes Zoomer magazine; and On The Bay Magazine, a regional lifestyle magazine published quarterly for the 20 towns and villages of Southern Georgian By, Ontario. Further, it provides online content services targeting the 45plus age group primarily through EverythingZoomer.com, as well as CARP.ca, VisionTV.ca, ONEtv.ca, ZoomerRadio.ca/am740.ca, and ClassicalFM.ca. Additionally, the company organizes ZoomerShows, an annual consumer shows directed to the Zoomer demographic; and ideaCity, an annual Canadian conference. ZoomerMedia Limited was founded in 2008 and is based in Toronto, Canada.

name: ZYUS Life Sciences Corporation
summary: ZYUS Life Sciences Corporation is a company listed on the TSX Venture Exchange under the ticker ZYUS and traded in CAD.

name: Zidane Capital Corp.
summary: Zidane Capital Corp. does not have significant operations. It focuses on the identification and evaluation of companies, businesses, assets, or properties to complete a qualifying transaction. The company was incorporated in 2010 and is based in Vancouver, Canada.
